theinfo.en:
I'm sorry about that scene, Allie is sometimes hard to deal with, unlike my daughter Jess.
Oh! Where are my manners. My name is Ae... You know what? I'll just write it.
Aeble
It's pronounced ahbluh, but everyone just calls me Able. You can call me that, I guess...
Aeble: I'm the CEO here at the Omnichannel, every broadcast you see, gets approved by me.
Now, I'm not the only one that does their part. Omnichannel has a board that helps administrate the various districts.
And what do you know...the board keeps getting reelected every year!
Omnichannel's goal is to open up the world to all. The only way to do that though, to make everyone equal,
Was to restrict Tuxemon.
We started with confiscation, but most Tuxemon managed to escape. So we were forced to resort to extreme measures.
Our sister organization Spyder developed a drug that could change Tuxemon.
It isolated a portion of the brain that every Tuxemon mysteriously has and overloaded it.
Once the Gage Paludal Lamina was overloaded with electricity, their will to resist faded and they became docile.
Because of some unexpected and tragic side effects, sadly, a few species are now effectively extinct,
Rockitten, Fruitera, and Hydrone specifically.
Now, outside of a few stragglers in the wild, this generation only interacts with Tuxemon when they work for us.
The birthrate is at an all time high, and approval of the Omnichannel has not fallen since the year before the restrictions.
Wild Tuxemon were a pervasive curse, threatening to destroying humanity. Omnichannel has fixed that and imposed order.
Unchecked, Tuxemon are a force of destruction and anyone who says otherwise is lying. Sorry, I must head to work.
theinfo.de:
Mir tut die Szene da Leid, Allie ist manchmal nicht einfach, im Gegensatz zu meiner Tochter Jess.
Oh! Wo sind bloß meine Manieren. Mein Name ist Ae... Weißt du was? Ich werde es einfach aufschreiben.
Aeble
Es wird ahbluh ausgesprochen, aber jeder nennt mich Able. Du kannst mich so nennen, schätze ich...
Aeble: Ich bin der CEO hier beim Omnichannel, jeder Rundfunk, den du siehst, wird von mir genehmigt.
Jetzt bin ich aber nicht der Einzige, der seinen Teil beiträgt, wir haben einen Vorstand, der uns hilft die Distrikte zu administrieren
Der Vorstand wurde seit der Gründung wiedergewählt. Sie haben jedoch einen großartigen Job gemacht, so macht es Sinn.
Omnichannel's Ziel ist es die Welt für alle zu öffnen. Der einzige Weg um dies zu erreichen jedoch, um alle gleich zu stellen,
war es nötig die Tuxemon einzuschränken.
Wir haben mit Beschlagnahmung angefangen, aber die meisten Tuxemon haben es geschafft zu entkommen. Also gingen wir zu extremen Maßnahmen über.
Unsere Schwesterorganisation hat eine Droge entwickelt, die die Tuxemon verändern konnte.
Es isolierte einen Teil des Gehirns, das jedes Tuxemon mysteriöserweise besitzt und überlud es.
Sobald die Gage Paludal Lamina mit Elektrizität überladen wurde, verschwand deren Wille zu widerstehen und sie wurden fügsam.
Deswegen sind einige Spezies tot,
besonders Rockitten, Fruitera, und Hydrone.
Das ist jedoch nicht mehr von Bedeutung. Diese Generation weiß nicht mal wer was Tuxemon sind, es sei denn sie arbeiten für uns.
Die Geburtenrate ist auf einem Allzeithoch, und die Genehmigung der Omnichannel wurde seit dem Jahr der Einschränkung nicht gestürzt
Tuxemon sind ein perverser Fluch, der die ganze Menschheit zerstört. Omnichannel hat das Problem gelöst und Ordnung gebracht.
Tuxemon zerstören und jeder, der was anderes behauptet, lügt. Entschuldigung, aber ich muss mich wieder an die Arbeit machen.

announcement5.en:
It has been a long, hard road to the peace and tranquility that now  reigns in the Fondent region.
However, it is my pleasure to announce, on this day, the 25th Anniversary of the founding of Omnichannel...
TUXEMON ARE CONTROLLED!
*deafening screaming*
Quiet Down! Quiet Down! Your enthusiasm is infectious I must say!
In conjunction with the Xero institute, we have stripped away their will to attack!
Due to this, we are confident that releasing Tuxemon into the wild is safe.
However, curfews must still be enforced, we are not a lawless region after all.
After all... WE ARE SAFETY, WE ARE ORDER, WE ARE OMNICHANNEL!
announcement5.de:
Es war ein langer, harter Weg zu dem Frieden und der Ruhe, die jetzt in der Region Fondent herrscht.
Es ist mir jedoch eine Freude, an diesem Tag den 25. Jahrestag der Gründung von Omnichannel bekannt zu geben...
TUXEMON ARE CONTROLLED!
*ohrenbetäubendes Geschrei*
Beruhigen Sie sich! Beruhigen Sie sich! Ihre Begeisterung ist ansteckend, muss ich sagen!
Gemeinsam mit dem Xero-Institut haben wir ihnen den Angriffswillen genommen!
Aus diesem Grund sind wir zuversichtlich, dass die Freilassung von Tuxemon in die Wildnis sicher ist.
Ausgangssperren müssen jedoch weiterhin durchgesetzt werden, wir sind schließlich keine rechtsfreie Region.
Letztendlich... WIR SIND SICHERHEIT, WIR SIND ORDNUNG, WIR SIND OMNICHANNEL!

moreannouncement.en: ATTENTION, ALL CITIZENS OF THE FONDENT REGION!

moreannouncement2.en:
I am sorry to give you such late notice about this address, but I believed it important before the media leaked it...
Well... Heh. We own the media, so I guess it wouldn't matter, but I wanted to share it all the same.
After consulting with my advisors, we have decided that the best way to become more comfortable with Tuxemon, is to use them.
Now, it will be some time before we can integrate them into the workforce, but in the meantime, as I said before, we will be releasing them into the wild.
I realize this is a shock for everyone, plus I understand that some of you may even be afraid. We all know what happened before...
This is not the time to be afraid though, as Omnichannel will be sponsoring the revival of the ancient tradition known as The Trial!
Now, for you who are less versed in Fondent region history, a hundred years ago there was a tradition where young men and women would catch and raise Tuxemon.
They would then use these Tuxemon to battle others and ascend rank in their town, with the best Tuxemon Trainers gaining status and power.
We will be creating a version of this for the modern day. We will be forming battle areas in multiple cities across Fondent.
Each Battle Area will need to be completed in order and the most promising trainer, or trainers, will be able to attempt the Championship.
The Championship will be held on top of Omnichannel Tower in Cotton Town, but only once a Tuxemon Trainer has made it through every Battle Area.
The Trial is designed as a way to slowly introduce public life to Tuxemon and to encourage travel throughout the region.
Who better to demonstrate this than our youth?
Each Match will be broadcast live on Omnichannel-T, the newest television station devoted exclusively to Tuxemon-related programming!
Don't worry, the addition will be reflected in your bill.
Oh, and one more thing, all Tuxemon Trainers will be exempt from the curfew.
Before this of course, you will need a Tuxemon! Now, not everyone can be allowed to become a Tuxemon Trainer. That would be pure chaos!
First, you'll have to register your name with your local Omnichannel representative and if you're selected, you'll be sent to Omnichannel training.
After successful completion of your training, you will be provided with a Tuxemon and can start participating in The Trial!
I look forward to meeting you all! Let's create a new world together!
After all... WE ARE SAFETY, WE ARE ORDER, WE ARE OMNICHANNEL! And now,
WE 
ARE 
THE 
FUTURE!

tuxemontimechoiceno.en: Oh... Okay... I'll be here if you change your mind...

tuxemontime2.en: Now, the first thing to do is get your papers all set...

tuxemontime3.1.en: Here are your registration papers, the first Battle Area will require you to present them in exchange for a Trainer badge.\nYou won't need the papers after that.

tuxemontime4.en: Now for the most important part! Choosing your Tuxemon!\nUnfortunately, my source of funding has become... hesitant as of late. This leaves you with only three choices of Tuxemon, sorry about that.\nThe three choices are Rockitten, Cardiling, and Tweesher.

choseRockitten.en: Alright, here's your Rockitten! I know that you two will go on great adventures together!

choseRockitten2.en: First though, let's test your battle prowess with a quick Tuxemon battle.\n Let's see... I'll choose Cardiling.

nochoiceTuxemon.en: Okay, why don't you take a look at the other two?

choseCardiling.en: Alright, here's your Cardiling! I know that you two will go on great adventures together!

choseCardiling2.en: First though, let's test your battle prowess with a quick Tuxemon battle.\n Let's see... I'll choose Tweesher.

choseTweesher.en: Alright, here's your Tweesher! I know that you two will go on great adventures together!

choseTweesher2.en: First though, let's test your battle prowess with a quick Tuxemon battle.\n Let's see... I'll choose Rockitten.

wewnicefight.en:
Wow, that was a good fight!
Let me heal your Tuxemon real quick...
And... There! All set!
With a little more practice and maybe a few more Tuxemon, you'll definitely be able to take on the Trial.

gasp2.en:
What are you doing here with this... Criminal?
... .... ....
... ... ...
Joining the trial? You'd really subject yourself to that nonsense?
If all you want is a job at Omnichannel, you could have just asked me.
I'm sure I can find a... use for you... if you're interested.

brokethegasp.en: Now, Miss, if I may, ${{name}} is doing it for more than a job.
brokethegasp.de: Nun, Fräulein, wenn ich darf, ${{name}} macht es für mehr als einen Job.

brokethegasp2.en: You. Why are you talking? I didn't allow you to speak.

brokethegasp3.en: Please, miss omnichannel ma'am, ${{name}}'s Mother wanted them to join the Trial to see the entire region\n${{name}} isn't doing it for the job, they're doing it for the experience.
brokethegasp3.de: Bitte, Miss Omnichannel Ma'am, ${{name}}'s Mutter wollte, dass sie an der Studie teilnehmen, um die gesamte Region zu sehen\n${{name}} tut es nicht für den Job, sie tun es für die Erfahrung.

gasp3.en: If that's true, there's more to you than I realized...

gasp4.en: Fine, I'll let your registration papers stay intact. For now.\nJohn, Grant, take the so-called Tuxemon Professor to his new home.

goodbye.en: Don't let the Trial prevent you from coming to see me. In fact... Maybe I'll find you first.

goodbye2.en: So long ${{name}}! And good luck in the Trial, you'll need it.
goodbye2.de: So lange ${{name}}! Und viel Glück in der Probe, du wirst es brauchen.

xero_hideout1.en: Xero Institute for Tuxemon Research and Advancement ahead.
xero_hideout1.de: Xero Institut für Tuxemon-Forschungen und -Förderung geradeaus.

tabatownbattlearea.en: Omnichannel Certified Battle Area - Taba Town

rockywhy.en: Wait, Rocky, don't stop here! We made it so far already!\nI know you like the grass, but we need to make it to Cotton Town!

heystop2.en: Miss, we already told you. Under section 2 of article 3, Omnichannel reserves the right to close down and maintain areas as needed.

heystop3.en: I KNOW THAT, BUT WHY? YOU JUST KICKED US OUT!

heystop4.en: Marissa, maybe we should leave for now, we'll come back another day.

heystop5.en: But... But... they dug up our flowers. Without a second thought, without asking.

heystop6.en: I know, but we can plant new flowers somewhere else. They'll still be special, because we'll plant them together.

heystop7.en: If they weren't so intent on bringing back Tuxemon, we'd still have our special flower patch...

soiwashearing.en: Well it looks like we finally found a florist everyone.

soiwashearing2.en: You, the florist, who are you?

soiwashearing3.en: My name is Marissa, and these... these... THUGS! Destroyed my flower patch.

soiwashearing4.en: How dare you...\nThis is the Premier you're talking to! Have some respect!

soiwashearing5.en: Ma'am, should I arrest her for addressing you so insolently?

soiwashearing6.en: No Julius, I don't think that's necessary.

soiwashearing7.en: She looks scared, the poor thing.

soiwashearing7.5.en: But anyone who hates omnichannel is a friend of mine.

soiwashearing8.en: Not to mention that the prisons are already overflowing with the... Flower City incident.

soiwashearing10.en: I expect to be addressed CORRECTLY.

soiwashearing11.en: Good, now move so I can talk to these so called \"knights.\"

allofyounow.en: Anyone without a Tuxemon needs to leave. This could get messy.

waityouhaveone.en:
You have a Tuxemon?
Why is that?
... .... ... ... 
... ... .... ... 
Trial eh? Well, hopefully you're good in a fight! I'll heal your Tuxemon real quick and then we'll see how good you really are.

taketheleft.en: You take the one on the left and I'll take the other three.

nobodygetsthrough.en: No matter who you bring with you, I won't let anyone through!

taketheleft2.en: Take the one on the left! Don't worry, I've got these three!

higrunts.en: These grunts don't even get proper training, so they were no match for me. You didn't do too bad either it looks like.

ohaimisa2.en: I heard that some Xero thug was beating up my men, but I didn't think it'd be you Misa!

ohaimisa3.en: Hi Kyle, why are you here?

ohaimisa4.en: Why am I here? Why, I'm the head of this project! Building the model Battle Area for the entire region is an honor!\nAlthough, I can see why you wouldn't have heard the news, frolicking about with your new plaything and all

ohaimisa6.en: Ah, doesn't matter. I have more important things to attend to anyways. Have fun you two, AND STOP HURTING MY MEN!\nToodles!

ohaimisa7.en: Jack, Rick, Eddy, come with me. Jon, you stay here.

kylekindasucks.en: Sorry about that, Kyle is one of my least favorite people at Omnichannel. And that's saying something!\nWe were in the same cohort at The Academy and he's been nothing but trouble since. That's probably why Omnichannel recruited him actually.\nLuckily, I don't have to listen to his grating voice every day like some poor souls have to.

kylekindasucks2.en: On a different note, it looks like Kyle was here to open the path. It seems like the Battle Area is open now.

kylekindasucks3.en: I know you're going through the Trial and all, but watch your back. Omnichannel is everywhere, watching everything.\nThey have no issue... disposing of troublesome individuals.

kylekindasucks4.en: I don't want to see another person disappear. Especially one as promising as you.

kylekindasucks5.en: Alright, I've probably been here long enough. Time for me to head back.

kylekindasucks7.en: I'll be watching you. In fact, I may even root for you.\nDon't let me down okay?

kylekindasucks8.en: You four, head home. Remember, YOU. SAW. NOTHING.\nUnderstand?\nOh, and florist? Come find me at some point. My address is on the card I gave you.

misaisleavingfornow2.en: Good Luck ${{name}}. I'm sure we'll see each other again.
misaisleavingfornow2.de: Viel Glück ${{name}}. Ich bin mir sicher, dass wir uns wiedersehen werden.

imherenow.en: I'm here to make sure nobody disrespects Omnichannel!\n... .... ... ...\nHow do I do that? Well... Uh... Maybe I'll ask them nicely?

oimate.en: Hey! This is a restricted area! No one without a badge is allowed in!

welcometotaba2.en: Congratulations on passing the strict Omnichannel evaluation!\nYour lucky group has been designated by Omnichannel to be the first contestants in the Trial!

welcometotaba3.en: Aren't there only three of us? Seems like we barely qualify as a \"group\".
welcometotaba3.de: Sind wir nicht nur zu dritt? Es scheint, als würden wir uns kaum als \"Gruppe\" qualifizieren.

welcometotaba4.en: To be honest, I thought more would pass the evaluation...
welcometotaba4.de: Um ehrlich zu sein, dachte ich, mehr würde die Bewertung bestehen...

welcometotaba5.en: Regardless, my name is Kyle and I am the lead architect behind the Battle Areas.\nI am here to inaugurate the first Fondent Region Battle Area and declare that...\nTHE TRIAL HAS BEGUN!
welcometotaba5.de: Unabhängig davon ist mein Name Kyle und ich bin der leitende Architekt hinter den Battle Areas.\nIch bin hier, um das erste Kampfgebiet der Fondent-Region einzuweihen und zu erklären, dass...\nDER TRIAL HAT BEGONNEN!

welcometotaba7.en: I'm not going to lie, I expected more enthusiasm from the first Trial Members.
welcometotaba7.de: Ich werde nicht lügen, ich habe mehr Begeisterung von den ersten Trial-Mitgliedern erwartet.

welcometotaba8.en: You're that thing that Misa was attached to. How'd you even get here? Did she falsify your papers to get you in?\n... .... ... ...\nAllie signed off on your papers? Interesting...
welcometotaba8.de: Du bist das Ding, an dem Misa hing. Wie bist du überhaupt hierher gekommen? Hat sie Ihre Papiere gefälscht, um Sie hinein zu bekommen?\n... .... ... ...\nAllie hat Ihre Papiere unterschrieben? Interessant...

welcometotaba9.en: Your papers seem to be in order. For now.
welcometotaba9.de: Ihre Papiere scheinen in Ordnung zu sein. Erst einmal.

welcometotaba10.en: However, this still doesn't explain the lack of enthusiasm. This is a big honor!\nBoth of you and Misa's plaything over there represent the best and brightest of the Fondent Region's youth!
welcometotaba10.de: Dies erklärt jedoch immer noch nicht den Mangel an Begeisterung. Das ist eine große Ehre!\nSie und Misas Spielzeug dort drüben repräsentieren die besten und klügsten Jugendlichen der Fondent-Region!

welcometotaba11.en: Sorry sir, but how is this an honor? I was forced into this. I didn't choose to be a part of the Trial.
welcometotaba11.de: Tut mir leid, Sir, aber wie ist das eine Ehre? Ich wurde dazu gezwungen. Ich habe mir nicht ausgesucht, Teil des Trial zu sein.

welcometotaba12.en: Admittedly, we did take some promising Omnichannel recruits and sent them into Trial training, so I apologize if that's the case.
welcometotaba12.de: Zugegeben, wir haben einige vielversprechende Omnichannel-Rekruten genommen und sie in ein Probetraining geschickt, also entschuldige ich mich, wenn das der Fall ist.

welcometotaba13.en: No sir, you imprisoned my family and forced me and my brother to join the Trial.\nSo forgive me if I \"lack enthusiasm\" when you're talking about the Trial.
welcometotaba13.de: Nein, Sir, Sie haben meine Familie eingesperrt und mich und meinen Bruder gezwungen, sich dem Prozess anzuschließen.\nVerzeihen Sie mir, wenn es mir \"an Begeisterung mangelt\", wenn Sie über den Prozess sprechen.

welcometotaba14.en: Ahh, you're the Flower City kid I've heard so much about. \"The Future of Omnichannel.\" What's your name?
welcometotaba14.de: Ahh, du bist das Flower City, von dem ich so viel gehört habe. \"Die Zukunft des Omnichannel.\" Wie heißen Sie?

kylereallysucks.en: Well, Speck, if it's any consolation, I was the one that gave the order to attack.
kylereallysucks.de: Nun, Speck, wenn es ein Trost ist, war ich derjenige, der den Befehl zum Angriff gab.

kylereallysucks2.en: Good Luck everyone! I fully expect none of you to make it!
kylereallysucks2.de: Viel Glück allerseits! Ich erwarte voll und ganz, dass keiner von euch es schafft!

kylereallysucks3.en: Oh, and Speck? I enjoyed the screams
kylereallysucks3.de: Oh, und Speck? Ich genoss die Schreie

dowehavetogoin.en: You know, you don't have to go in. Just go through the standard training program, skip the Trial.
dowehavetogoin.de: Weißt du, du musst nicht hineingehen. Gehen Sie einfach das Standard-Trainingsprogramm durch und überspringen Sie die Trial.

dowehavetogoin2.en: No, you don't understand. The only way I can get my family out of prison is if I reach a high enough rank in Omnichannel.\nFinishing the Trial would set me up in a position just below the CEO. I'd be able to change things.\nIf I finish this, I can save my family...
dowehavetogoin2.de: Nein, das verstehst du nicht. Der einzige Weg, wie ich meine Familie aus dem Gefängnis holen kann, ist, wenn ich einen ausreichend hohen Rang im Omnichannel erreiche.\nDas Beenden der Studie würde mich in eine Position direkt unter dem CEO bringen. Ich wäre in der Lage, Dinge zu ändern.\nWenn ich das beende, kann ich meine Familie retten...

dowehavetogoin3.en: I have to go in, no matter how much I don't want to, I have to help the people I love.
dowehavetogoin3.de: Ich muss hineingehen, egal wie sehr ich es nicht will, ich muss den Menschen helfen, die ich liebe.

dowehavetogoin4.en: Who knows, maybe I'll be able to fight him myself!
dowehavetogoin4.de: Wer weiß, vielleicht kann ich selbst gegen ihn kämpfen!

dowehavetogoin5.en: By the way, what's your name? Kyle didn't seem to address you at all.
dowehavetogoin5.de: Übrigens, wie ist dein Name? Kyle schien dich überhaupt nicht anzusprechen.

hichristie.en: Oh, my name is Christie! Sorry, I should have mentioned that before.
hichristie.de: Oh, mein Name ist Christie! Entschuldigung, das hätte ich vorher erwähnen sollen.

hichristie2.en: Hi Christie. As you know, I'm Speck. It's nice to meet you.\nNow...
hichristie2.de: Hallo Christie. Wie Sie wissen, bin ich Speck. Es ist schön, Sie kennenzulernen.\nJetzt...

hiperson.en: Who are you, who's Misa, and who's Allie? Give us the deets!
hiperson.de: Wer bist du, wer ist Misa und wer ist Allie? Geben Sie uns die Details!

hiperson2.en: Whoa there Christie, don't overwhelm them.
hiperson2.de: Whoa da Christie, überwältige sie nicht.

hiperson3.en: How about we start with a name and where you're from?
hiperson3.de: Wie wäre es, wenn wir mit einem Namen beginnen und woher Sie kommen?

hiperson5.en: Oh, so you're from Taba Town! Neat!
hiperson5.de: Oh, du kommst also aus Taba Town! Ordentlich!

hiperson6.en: Now, who are Misa and Allie?
hiperson6.de: Nun, wer sind Misa und Allie?

somebody2.en: Oooh. Are they special to you then? Is there a love triangle going around? C'mon! We need to know!
somebody2.de: Oooh. Sind sie dann etwas Besonderes für Sie? Gibt es eine Dreiecksbeziehung? Komm schon! Wir müssen wissen

stahp.en: Hey Christie, don't interrogate them. We just met after all. \nMaybe we should head in anyways. We don't want to make Kyle angry.

stahp3.en: But don't think you're avoiding this conversation! I'll get the deets out of you soon enough!

column1.en: A rare and ancient column. This used to be part of a temple.
column1.de: Eine seltene und antike Säule. Dies war mal ein Tempel.

column2.en: A rare and ancient column. Other ruins from the same culture can be found on Route 3.
column2.de: Eine seltene und antike Säule. Andere Ruinen von der selben Kultur können auf Route 3 gefunden werden.

route2speech2.en: Oh. It's just you ${{name}}...\nBe more considerate the next time you push someone. The cliff is higher than it looks...
route2speech2.de: Oh. Du bist es nur, ${{name}}...\nSei das nächste Mal etwas rücksichtsvoller wenn du jemanden schubst. Die Klippe geht weiter runter als es aussieht...

route2speech3.en: Although that may not be a bad thing...\nI know, everyone needs me to lead, but with everything going on...\nBut you don't want to listen to me... do you?
route2speech3.de: Obwohl das keine schlechte Sache ist...\nIch weiß, jeder braucht mich zum Anführen, aber mit allem, was vor sich geht...\nAber du willst mir gar nicht zuhören... oder?

notalk.en: How insensitive of you! Too bad, you'll have to listen to me anyway!
notalk.de: Du unsensible Person! Du wirst mir sowieso zuhören!

spillit.en: You know that I am the leader of the Xero institute and that I recruited you to fight them. But you don't know something else.\nAllie, who you met before... What? I told you we would be watching, you don't have to be surprised by it.
spillit.de: Du weißt, dass ich das Xero institut leite und dass ich dich rekrutiert habe, um sie zu bekämpfen. Aber sonst weißt du nichts weiter.\nAllie, die, die du zuvor kennengelernt hast... Was? Ich habe dir gesagt, dass wir beobachten, du brauchst nicht so überrascht darüber zu sein.

spillit3.en: Whatever... Allie is my sister and means the world to me, so it destroyed me when I found out he had taken her to HQ.
spillit3.de: Wie auch immer... Allie ist meine Schwester und bedeutet mir die Welt, deshalb war ich am Boden zerstört, als ich herausgefunden habe, dass er sie ins HQ gebracht hat.

spillit4.en: It may not seem like a bad thing, but it is. Do you know what they do to their recruits? DO YOU!?
spillit4.de: Es mag vielleicht nicht den Eindruck von etwas Schlechtem zu machen, aber es ist etwas Schlechtes. Weißt du, was die ihnen antun? Weißt du es!?

spillit5.en: Because neither do I... All I know is that no one has ever left Omnichannel after being recruited.
spillit5.de: Denn ich auch nicht... Alles, was ich weiß, ist, dass niemand jemals Omnichannel nach der Rekrutierung verlassen hat.

spillit6.en: Anyways... it doesn't concern you. All that matters is bringing down Omnichannel.
spillit6.de: Wie auch immer... Es betrifft dich nicht. Alles, was gerade wichtig ist, ist, dass Omnichannel zu Fall gebracht wird.

spillit7.en: I'm sorry for troubling you with my issues. City Park is up ahead when you want to move on
spillit7.de: Tut mir Leid, dass ich dich mit meinen Problemen belaste. City Park ist weter vorne, wenn du weitergehen möchtest

leavemealone.en: We used to play here all the time when we were younger...
leavemealone.de: Wir haben hier früher immer gespielt als wir noch jünger waren...

rubberduck_cave_01.en: A good place to hide an item

rubberduck_city_03.en: Here you should be able to heal your monsters ... but no one here ...

rubberduck_city_05.en: Currently no one is living here

rubberduck_city_06.en: Maybe someone evil / bad should be here

rubberduck_city_07.en: Maybe make this door opened and put someone here

rubberduck_city_08.en: Place for a cave route... maybe cave_01.tmx

rubberduck_city_10.en: This is a secret place that can't be reached yet...

old_sphalian_center01.en: Your tuxemon are now at full health!

old_sphalian_center02.en: It says that it is under repair

old_sphalian_town01.en: Sphalian Town - a quiet, peaceful place

old_sphalian_house01.en: You watch some TV with your beloved Lv ${{monster_0_level}} ${{monster_0_name}}.,0

spyder_hospital1_nurse1.en: You have to stop them!\n These villains have taken over the hospital,\n and they're stopping us from releasing the cure.

spyder_hospital1_pem1.en: I don't recognize you from the induction.

spyder_hospital1_scientist1.en: We didn't want these tuxemon to be seized, but while they're here we're going to look after them.

spyder_hospital1_scientist2.en: Let's make the most of the situation.

spyder_hospital_pc_message_rivalry1.en: E-mail from Researcher 1\n 'Researcher 2, I'm not sure I agree with your approach. We need to be more careful and methodical in our research.\n Your simulations are promising, but we can't rush into conclusions.'

spyder_hospital_pc_message_rivalry2.en: E-mail from Researcher 2\n 'Researcher 1, you're always so cautious and slow. We need to take risks and push the boundaries of what's possible.\n Our research is too important to be held back by your fear of failure.'

spyder_hospital1_rea1.en: Confiscating all the tuxemon was a waste of time.\n No trainer can stop the super-monsters that Spyder is breeding.

spyder_hospital2_nurse1.en: Quarantines have their use, especially for people who don't have tuxemon to heal them,\n but Spyder have used this one very cynically.

spyder_hospital_pc_message1.en: E-mail from Researcher 1\n 'Dr. Lee, I've been analyzing the virus samples, and I think we should try a different strain.\n It might trigger a new reaction in the antibodies.'

spyder_hospital_pc_message2.en: Note from Researcher 2\n 'Dr. Lee, I've found a potential combination of enzymes and antibodies that could slow down the mutation rate.\n I'm running simulations now.'

spyder_hospital_pc_message3.en: Simulation results from Researcher 2\n 'The enzyme-antibody combination shows promising results. We might have a cure on our hands.'

spyder_hospital_pc_message6.en: E-mail from Researcher 1\n 'Dr. Lee, I've managed to isolate a new strain of the virus that seems susceptible to our current treatments.\n However, I'm concerned about the security implications of this discovery. We need to be extra cautious about who knows about this.'

spyder_hospital_pc_message9.en: E-mail from Robot Assistant\n 'I have detected unauthorized access to your research files. Please investigate immediately.'

spyder_hospital_pc_message4.en: E-mail from Enforcer\n 'Dr. Lee, we have reason to believe that you have been conducting unauthorized research. We are at your location and require you to come with us.'

spyder_hospital_pc_message5.en: E-mail from Dr. Lee to Dr. Chen, Mentor\n 'They are destroying my door, they want to arrest me because of unauthorized research. I can't let them take this away from me.\n This is a breakthrough, a real cure. I need to share it with the world.'

spyder_hospital_pc_message7.en:
E-mail from Enforcer: 'Dr Lee
 we have received intelligence indicating that you're conducting unauthorized research within the company.
 We have reason to believe that your work poses a significant threat to our organization.
 You're hereby ordered to cease all research immediately and report to the security office.'

spyder_hospital_pc_message8.en: E-mail from Mysterious Informant\n 'There are people who want to see you fail. They will stop at nothing to destroy your work. Be careful.'

spyder_hospital_warning1.en: Bzzzz. Lifeform detected. \n Doors remain closed.

spyder_hospital_nurse1.en: The screen is set up to detect and reject humans and tuxemon. \n It has been encoded with the DNA of all known tuxemon!

spyder_hospital_warning2.en: \"Aardant\" is not a recognized lifeform. \n Shutting down.

spyder_hospital_cure1.en: It's the cure to the Spyder Bite infection! \n With this, you can cure your own and others' tuxemon.

spyder_hospital_billie1.en: ${{name}}, your meddling has become too much! Just let the authorities do their jobs!
spyder_hospital_billie1.de: ${{name}}, deine Einmischung ist zu viel geworden! Lasst die Behörden einfach ihre Arbeit machen!

spyder_hospital_billie2.en:
Wait ... your tuxemon aren't sick! 
 ... 
 It was that simple? 
 Then why did the Enforcers take our tuxemon instead of just curing them? ...

spyder_flower_artist_clipping.en: A newspaper clipping is on the wall. It begins: \n \"The famous art critic has put away his poison pen and picked up the paint brush. \n After years of tearing down artists, can he do any better himself?\"

spyder_flower_artist1.en: Simplistic and clumsy brushstrokes and a pedestrian theme. Bah! Another ruined canvas.

spyder_flower_muse1.en: He's so hard on himself, never happy with something he's painted. He's so forgetful, too. Perhaps I could buy a painting

spyder_flower_muse2.en: What? You have a painting. Oooh - would you let me buy it? I have ${{currency}}2,000.
spyder_flower_muse2.de: Was? Sie haben ein Gemälde. Oooh - würdest du mich es kaufen lassen? Ich habe ${{currency}}2.000.

spyder_flower_muse4.en: What? You have all the paintings. Oooh - would you let me buy it? I have ${{currency}}6,000.

spyder_flower_muse3.en: Thank you, he's much better company now. \n Although ... he was saying something about taking up digital art!

spyder_flower_artist2.en: Magnificent! I didn't know I had it in me. \n I don't know what those artist were complaining about - painting is easy!

spyder_candyhouse2_captain.en: I'm writing a book about my journey to the Archipelago. It is composed of nine volcanic islands.\nAbout 1,400 km (870 mi) west of Paper Town, about 1,500 km (930 mi) north west of Candy Town.

spyder_candy_prof1.en: ZUNNA! This darn tuxemon is eating me out of house and home.

spyder_candy_prof_nocateye.en: I wish I could trade it for a nice quite tuxemon, like a CATEYE.

spyder_candy_prof_willtrade.en: I'm the luckiest professor in the region of Fondent.

spyder_candy_catgirl1.en: You know, I'm just fascinated by fossils. You know - SHAMMER, RHINCUS, that kind of thing.

spyder_candy_catgirl_nofossil.en: No? Well, you know where you can find me.

spyder_candy_catgirl2.en: Do you have a fossil tuxemon?

spyder_candy_catgirl_willtrade.en: You do? Want to trade it for a PROPELLERCAT?

spyder_enforcer_candy3.en: Ha! I mean, oh dear, your tuxemon are infected and must be quarantined.\n Hand them over now ...

spyder_enforcer_candy4.en: Don't you even think of trying to steal your tuxemon back from the Hospital.\n The scanners are set up to reject all known tuxemon and human DNA!

spyder_enforcer_candy1.en: Stop right there!\n We are taking all infected tuxemon to the Hospital to be quarantined\n until Greenwash develops a cure for the virus.

spyder_greenwash_guard.en: Alright, alright, nothing to see here.
spyder_greenwash_guard.de: Okay, okay, hier gibt es nichts zu sehen.

spyder_candy_eliane1.en: Welcome to my market garden.\n I grow plants.\n Would you like me to harvest some crops for you?

spyder_candy_eliane2.en: How did you enjoy the fruits of my labors?

spyder_enforcer_candy2.en: Wow! I guess you get to keep them all\n ... Uh ... I mean, good job keeping your tuxemon free from disease.\n You may go.

spyder_citypark_granny.en: We'll walk back to Leather Town after a little rest.
spyder_citypark_granny.de: Nach einer kleinen Pause gehen wir zurück ins Leder Dorf.

spyder_citypark_maniac.de: Puh, wir sind fix und fertig!

spyder_citypark_florist.en: Enjoy the flower display! It's the pride of Leather Town.
spyder_citypark_florist.de: Genießen Sie die Blumenausstellung! Es ist der ganze Stolz von Leder Dorf.

spyder_citypark2_florist.en: The flowers look okay, don't they? ... Ever since the mining began in Leather Town, the flowers have been under the weather!
spyder_citypark2_florist.de: Die Blumen sehen okay aus, oder? ... Seit Beginn des Bergbaus im Leder Dorf sind die Blumen dem Wetter ausgesetzt!

spyder_generic_nurse.en: Hey, you look tired. Let me help you feel better!

spyder_output_nurse1.en: You should be good as new now! Just take it easy for a bit and you'll be back to your old self in no time.

spyder_citypark_house_maniac1.en:
I'm the Achievement Maniac! I'm young ... Well, at heart. My body is old and frail.
All my life, my dream has been to do the things that no one else has done.
Like ... giving a dog tuxemon to a Cat Girl.
I wrote down all the things I wanted to do in my Book of Wishes. But it's unfinished ...

spyder_citypark_house_maniac2.en: Do you want to help me? You can do all the challenges that I didn't get around to!

spyder_citypark_house_maniac3.en: Huh, nothing new. Well, keep working on it!

spyder_cottonart_florist.en: What do you think of the blue painting of a ship in the harbor? \n It's in the impressionist style - that means it tries to capture how light looks and behaves. \n See the small red sun reflected along the waves of the water?

spyder_cottonart_granny.en: I must be getting nostalgic. I almost said \n \"Back in my day, things were better!\"

spyder_cottonart_goth.en: I used to enjoy coming here every weekend to look at the paintings. \n Now all the best ones have been sold and the tickets are too expensive. \n But my nanna wanted to come, so ...

spyder_cottonart_barmaid_bundle_sold.en: It looks like you're my collector now! I'll replace the original with copies!

spyder_cottonart_shopkeeper.en: Welcome to the Cotton Town Art Gallery. Ah - I mean Art Shop! \n Ever since they cut our funding, we've had to sell the artworks instead of just displaying them. \n Entry is ${{currency}}50. It goes toward the company's annual dividend.
spyder_cottonart_shopkeeper.de: Willkommen in der Cotton Town Art Gallery. Ah - ich meine Art Shop!\nSeit sie unsere Finanzierung gekürzt haben, mussten wir die Kunstwerke verkaufen, anstatt sie nur auszustellen.\nDer Eintrag ist ${{currency}}50. Er fließt in die jährliche Dividende des Unternehmens.

spyder_cottonart_barmaid.en:
Do you like my set? 
 They capture my early days as a professional tuxemon trainer, before I retired on my winnings. 
  I call them: 'Monsters' Eyes Meet', 'Starry, Starry, Starry Night' and 'Trepidation'. They're for sale! 
 Get them while they're hot! Just 1,000 each.

spyder_cottonart_barmaid_bundle.en: Do you want to buy all three paintings for ${{currency}}3,000?

p_starry_night_description.en: Painting 'Starry, Starry, Starry Night', medium: oil on canvas. Hand-signed by the artist.

spyder_cottonart_barmaid_single.en: Do you want to buy this painting for ${{currency}}1,000?

p_trepidation_description.en: Painting 'Trepidation', medium: oil on canvas. Hand-signed by the artist.

p_monsters_eyes_description.en: Painting 'Monsters' Eyes Meet', medium: oil on canvas. Hand-signed by the artist.

spyder_cottonart_barmaid_painting_sold_b.en: The painting has been bought and donated back to the gallery by Billie!

spyder_cottonart_billie.en: I see you're trying to broaden your horizons. That's cute. Just try not to touch anything.

spyder_cottoncafe_hackerchat.en:
It's so cool that you're helping with Tuxepedia.
  ... 
 Is there a prize for adding all the tuxemon? 
 Only the satisfaction of helping the human race, buddy.

spyder_cottoncafe_barmaid.en: Welcome back. Shall I chuck your tuxemon in the healing unit?

spyder_cotton_tuxepediawelcome.en: Good to see you. You're just in time.

spyder_cotton_tuxepediaintro.en:
Currently, the only reliable information about tuxemon is from the expensive and incomplete Encyclopaedia Tuxemon! 
 That's not cool; information should be freely available. That's why we're introducing Tuxepedia. 
 It's open source, it's free, it's available for everyone to read, write and edit. How cool is that? 
 You can open Tuxepedia from the menu.

spyder_cotton_tuxepediaintro2.en: All it takes to add information is for you to catch that particular tuxemon. It's so cool.

spyder_cotton_tuxepediaintro4.en: It's so cool that you came. There's still so many tuxemon to be added - over a hundred, I think. \n You could really get into it, and make a difference to the world.

spyder_cottoncafe_barmaidintro.en:
We call ourselves Team Bazaar. Maybe that's a little pretentious. 
 We're a group of rogues and scoundrels who like to get together to drink coffee, discuss philosophy and defy our corporate overlords! 
 We try to look out for each other. For example, unlike the Cathedral we don't charge for you to heal your tuxemon! 
 Would you like me to heal them now?

spyder_cotton_cafegoth.en: Don't look at me. I'm just here for the free canapes and heals.

spyder_cotton_cafeflorist2.en: I can't wait to fact-check everyone else's entries. \n You better make sure you have good sources!

spyder_cotton_cafegranny.en: Hmm, I'm not sure I fancy this coffee.

spyder_cotton_cafeassistant.en: Do you collect tuxemon? I'd like to start but I'm afraid to leave the city.

spyder_cotton_homemaker2.en: Tuxepedia is great, isn't it? I'm one of the programmers. Tell me if you find any bugs.

spyder_cotton_homemaker1.en: Are you here for the talk? I'm so excited for the launch.

spyder_lostfight.en: I guess I shouldn't have picked that fight. But it's the spirit, the spirit of too much coffee, that matters!

spyder_request_fight.en: Do you want a quick battle?

spyder_cottonhouse1_homemaker.en: I feel so safe seeing all the Enforcers around. You can never be too careful. \n The newspapers are always reporting terrible crimes in this very region!

spyder_cottonhouse1_firefighter.en: Did you know it's possible for tuxemon to have two elements? \n Even a technique can belong to two elements at one.

spyder_cottonhouse1_tvwatch.en: It's the latest reality show: people and their tuxemon complete challenges on a remote island.

spyder_cottonhouse2_magician.en: Some conditions replace one another. \n Learning how conditions interact is key to becoming a master of tuxemon fighting.

spyder_cottonhouse2_catgirl.en: Have you met the old man in City Park? He's obsessed with breaking records!

spyder_cottonhouse2_shopkeeper.en: I don't have a problem with people from other regions. \n Just don't come after my job, alright?

spyder_cottonscoop_shopassistant.en: Tuxeballs allow you to capture tuxemon and keep them as servants. \n They're most effective when used on injured and low-level tuxemon. \n Select them during battle from your Item menu.

spyder_cottonscoop_devicenoexplan.en: Okay, well here's five as a free sample. \n If you have any questions about how Tuxeballs work, just ask my assistant!

spyder_cottonscoop_deviceexplan2.en: Tuxeballs allow you to capture tuxemon and keep them as servants. \n They're most effective when used on injured and low-level tuxemon. Select them during battle from your Item menu. \n Thank you for listening. Here's five Tuxeballs as a free sample.

spyder_cottonscoop_deviceoffer.en: Welcome customer. Today, we're promoting Tuxeballs. Do you know what those are?

spyder_cottontown_hackerintro.en:
Hey, cool tuxemon! Can I see the receipt? 
 ... 
 Just kidding, I had a feeling you hadn't picked it up using, ah, official channels. 
 For years, the Five Pillars have controlled the strongest tuxemon. 
 Do you think it'd be cool to poke them in the eye? 
 ... 
 Good! I have a project for you. Meet me in the Cafe!

spyder_cottontown_monk.en: I am assigned by the Dojo of the Elements to tend the statues here. \n But Omnichannel is planning to expand its offices into this space. \n I don't know what will happen to the statues when they do.

spyder_cottontown_stopthere.en: Hey, that's not cool! You have to come to my talk at the cafe before you run off!

spyder_cottontown_followme.en: The Cafe is located on the other side of these houses.

welcome_location_town.de: Willkommen in ${{map_name}} Town: ${{map_desc}}\nNord: ${{north}} / Süd: ${{south}} / West: ${{west}} / Ost: ${{east}}

spyder_cottontown_mom.en:
Well hello stranger! What are you doing going into a Cafe? 
 You know caffeine is bad for you. I'm kidding! 
 You're a grown up of 12 years old, you can do whatever you like! ... No alcohol .... 
 But you should call home more often. I want someone to tell about my inventions. 
 ... Oh, I forget, you haven't got a phone yet. Here's one I invented. I call it the Nu Phone! 
 You can install all sorts of apps on it. It already has the Map App, so you'll never get lost!

spyder_cotton_lazybrute.en: Buzz off, this tunnel is still under construction.

spyder_cottontown_mom1.en: Talk about a parting shot!\n Omnichannel seems to have pulled the plug on the region's computer network.\n At least, I hope it's nothing more serious than that.

spyder_cottontown_hacker1.en: Great work on Tuxepedia, my friend.\n You're our top contributor.

spyder_cottontown_hacker2.en: Right, right!\n There's a data center along the river to the north-east of Timber Town.\n If Omnichannel's done anything to the computer network, they would have done it there.

spyder_confused1.en: This guy won't let me through! I can't figure out how to get out of town! If I win, you have to tell me how! \n If I lose... the same!

spyder_confused2.en: Oh, you say there is another way out on the opposite side of town? Just go right and go straight past the heal center? Thanks!

spyder_datacenter_billie1.en:
Great job, ${{name}}. Looks like Omnichannel let their AI out just to spite us.
 You know, you're making quite a habit of saving the region.
 You should take a break for a change.
 I hear there's a new walking trail that has opened up behind the old Mansion outside Flower City.
 Might be worth checking out.
 Me? I'm going to be a little busy over the next while.
 Let's just say they've finally let me into an exclusive club.
 Come on, you're not going to make me give up all my perks, are you?

spyder_dojo_wan3.en: Each monk in this room specializes in monsters of a particular element, \n but each has found a way to develop their strengths and to mitigate their weaknesses. \n Talk to me once you have defeated them all.

spyder_dojo_wan1.en: On this level, you must prove your mastery of the elements that make up everything in the universe.

spyder_dojo_wan4.en: Congratulations. \n Now prove what you have learned in battle against me.

spyder_dojo_tu3.en: Each monk in this room specializes in monsters with one very high stat.\n To overcome this, you will have to make clever use of your own creatures' stats. \n Talk to me once you have defeated them all.

spyder_dojo_tu1.en: On this level you must prove your mastery of the six vital statistics of tuxemon:\n HP, Melee, Ranged, Armor, Dodge and Speed.

spyder_dojo_tu4.en: Congratulations.\n Now prove what you have learned in battle against me

spyder_dojo_thri1.en: Congratulations, you have proven yourself an excellent trainer. \n You will face only one further adversary: me!

spyder_dojo_thri2.en: You are a true master of battle and have earned a reward. \n Tell me, do you favor strength or strategy?

spyder_dojo_strength.en: In that case, take this SAMPSACK. Its power is unrivalled.

spyder_dojo_strategy.en: In that case, take this SAMPSAGE. Its cunning is unrivalled.

spyder_dojo_billie1.en: Hey cheapskate! I'm training here too. You know, this Tuxepedia thing isn't half bad. \n I bet you only like it cos it's free, though.

spyder_dojo_billie2.en: Hmmm, I can tell from your Tuxepedia edits that you know your stuff.

spyder_dojo_billie3.en: Billie has added their tuxemon data to TUXEPEDIA.

spyder_papertown_tvwatch.en: What's on TV? A prom queen is breaking her tiara into pieces and handing it out.

spyder_papertown_mom1.en: Good morning sunshine! Rest here any time you like. \n Why am I saying that? You live here!

spyder_papertown_mom2.en: Hello dear. I should get on with my inventing. \n Can't you occupy yourself? \n Back in my day, we could amuse ourselves with anything - a stick, a rock, rubbish we found in bins ...

spyder_papertown_mom4.en: Welcome back! Look at you, growing up so fast.

spyder_papertown_mom5.en: You know, Granny Piper next door has opened up her Daycare Centre. \n Well, not everyone can be an inventor, I guess.

spyder_papertown_mom6.en: Congratulations! You took down the corporations! \n Of course, now lots of people don't have a job ... but you did the right thing. I think.

spyder_papertown_mom3.en: Oh, you found yourself a tuxemon. Congratulations! \n Why don't you head over to the next town and explore?

spyder_dragonscave_mallory3.en:
The Drokoro is ours! 
 We got Shaft to dig it up from beneath Route 3, and we would have kept it if that infuriating kid hadn't interrupted our plans. 
 It is time for the Pillars to combine their strength and rule this region outright! 
 Too long have we let the Cathedral and the public tell us what can and cannot be done with Tuxemon. 
 When we use Greenwash's fusion technology to combine this Drokoro with the killer robots built by Nimrod, we will be unstoppable! 
 And the best part is, Omnichannel will tell the public that this is all in their best interests - and the public will believe them!

spyder_dragonscave_benden4.en: Please, ${{name}}. If you can't stop these villains, all is lost.
spyder_dragonscave_benden4.de: Bitte, ${{name}}. Wenn du diese Schurken nicht aufhalten kannst, ist alles verloren.

spyder_dragonscave_tru1.en: This is for your own good, okay?

spyder_dragonscave_tru2.en: Whatever. We already took the DNA sample. \n We just wanted to capture Drokoro as a backup. \n You'll never stop them back at Omnichannel HQ.

spyder_output_nurse2.en: All better! I'm glad I could help. You were looking a bit rough there for a second.

spyder_dryadsgrove_boy_healthy.en: Wow, your monsters look really healthy! That's so great.\n You must be rich to be able to look after them so well.\n Hey -- if I gave you my buddy RUFF, you'd look after her, right?

spyder_dryadsgrove_dad1.en: I feel bad. When we got him that WOLFFSKY for his birthday, we never realized how much the vet fees would be.\n We just can't afford them. And then RUFF got in that fight ...

spyder_dryadsgrove_boy_not_healthy.en: Hey, your monsters are in rough shape. I understand what you're going through.\n My WOLFFSKY got herself hurt, but we can't afford the doctor's fees just now to look after her. It's rough.

spyder_dryadsgrove_boy_yes.en: *SNIFF* I'm going to miss you, buddy. But it's for the best.

spyder_dryadsgrove_boy_no.en: Oh. Yeah. Fair enough. It's real expensive, I know.

spyder_dryadsgrove_boy_after.en: Hey, how's RUFF going? You're taking good care of her, right?

spyder_dryadsgrove_boy_after_no.en: *SNIFF* I understand. It's easy to get attached, and RUFF looks like he's doing really well. Bye RUFF.

spyder_dryadsgrove_boy_after_yes.en: Oh wow! Oh wow! You just made my day. My week! My year! I missed RUFF so much.\n *SNIFF* You're the best!

spyder_flower_mieke1.en: It's exciting for us to visit the region of Fondant! You have such unique tuxemon here ... \n Hey, do you want to trade? My Conileaf for a creature that we don't have back home ... \n How about Budaye?

spyder_flower_mieke_nobudaye.en: Oh it doesn't matter - I can see you don't have a Budaye.

spyder_flower_teach1.en: Oh where has my other student gotten to?
