welcome_location_city.de: Willkommen in ${{map_name}} City: ${{map_desc}}\nNord: ${{north}} / Süd: ${{south}} / West: ${{west}} / Ost: ${{east}}

spyder_flower_dojo_sign.en: Dojo of the Elements: Master Tuxemon Battle

spyder_flower_florist.en: There used to be a riverboat captain here who could take you up and down the river. \n But I haven't seen him for a few days.

spyder_flower_fez1.en: Everyone in our region has to pick from one of the same five boring tuxemon. \n I know like a hundred people with a Foxfire ... \n Hey, do you want to trade? My Foxfire for an Ignibus?

spyder_flower_fez_noignibus.en: Oh it doesn't matter - I can see you don't have an Ignibus.

spyder_flower_cady1.en: Oh I'd just love to have a souvenier to take back home with me. \n I just adore those sweet little Grintot. Could you get me one? \n I could give you my Hampotamos in exchange?

spyder_flower_cady_nogrintot.en: Oh it doesn't matter - I can see you don't have a Grintot.

spyder_flower_sandy1.en: This Pharfan keeps spraying me with water. What a drag! \n Hey, do you want it? You'd have to give me a Tweesher in return.

spyder_flower_sandy_notweesher.en: Oh it doesn't matter - I can see you don't have a Tweesher.

spyder_river_captain2.en: Ahoy there! Where would you like to go?

spyder_flower_monk1.en: I'm sorry, only experienced trainers are allowed past this point.

spyder_flower_sign.en: The sign reads, 'Caution: Testing in progress. Please use the building entrance for secure access.'

spyder_flower_guard.en: Access restricted. Only those who've completed the combat evaluation at the Dojo are cleared for entry. \nOrders from above — no exceptions.

spyder_greenwash_looten3.en: Here's the closest we've come -- it's a cute fusion of an ant and an Aardorn.\n Not exactly the ultimate killing machine Omnichannel wanted us to create.\n I mean … uh! You didn't hear that from me.

spyder_greenwash_looten4.en: The funny thing is, because of its fusion DNA, it makes DNA screeners behave all funny.

spyder_greenwash_firefighter.en: I could battle you, but I prefer to appeal to your reason and common sense.\n If you don't get out of here, the building might fall on you!

spyder_greenwash_fossilisator1.en: Hello there, I suppose you are here to see my finest invention - the De-Fossilator.\n ... No? You're here to investigate why the Greenwash staff went on strike\n and got locked out by the Enforcers?

spyder_greenwash_fossilisator2.en: While you're here you might as well see the De-Fossilator in action.

spyder_greenwash_fossilisator3.en: Ah, I see you have a toothed bird fossil. Shall I de-fossilate it?

spyder_greenwash_fossilisator5.en: Ah, I see you have an ancient dog fossil. Shall I de-fossilate it?

spyder_greenwash_fossilisator4.en: It worked! The fossil turned into a Rhincus!

spyder_greenwash_fossilisator6.en: It worked! The fossil turned into a Shammer!

spyder_greenwash_fossilisator8.en: Ah, I see you have two ancient fossils. Shall I de-fossilate both?

spyder_greenwash_fossilisator9.en: It worked! The fossils turned into a Shammer and a Rhincus!

spyder_pc_recorded_conversation.en: Found a recorded conversation on PC. Play back?

spyder_leatherhouse1_florist.en: There used to be several TV and radio stations operating, but Omnichannel ran them out of business. \n Now we don't have to worry about different journalists contradicting each other.

spyder_leatherhouse1_tennisplayer1.en: Is Grinflare an Earth element tuxemon or a Fire element tuxemon?

spyder_leatherhouse2_tv.en: A little green mon is lifting a ship out of a swamp.

spyder_leatherhouse2_scientist.en:
I work for Shaft. 
 ... 
 Where's my helmet? I don't need one, I control the truck remotely from our offices. 
 Pretty soon, most jobs in the mines will be automated.

spyder_leatherhouse2_miner.en: You won't believe what they're digging up in Route 3. \n I've never seen an egg that big. \n Oops, I've said too much.

spyder_leatherhouse2_snugglepot.en: Wow! One day I'm going to be a trainer just like you!

spyder_leathershaft1_sign.en: Journey to the Center of the Earth!

spyder_leathershaft1_roxby1.en: Some islands in the archipelago are completely taken over by mining. It is not possible to differentiate\nbetween an indigenous community and a mining area. There is not even water to drink. Shaft is against!

spyder_leathershaft1_miner1.en: It is important to protect indigenous people, land... but we cannot criminalize the miners\nwho are looking for a living to survive. What matters is that the miners are protected!

spyder_leathershaft1_beryll1.en: In Fondent alone there are about a dozen locations where illegal or artisan mining is going on\nbut Shaft is viewed as evil.

spyder_leathershaft1_rutherford1.en: Shaft leader is a thinker and doer. She is not a talker. She has met twice with the miners. It shows quality.\nIt shows her plans for Fondent. Our leader has been consistent when it comes to climate change.

spyder_leathershaft1_surat1.en: To streamline the mining sector, someone started to give certificates to those qualified to mine.\nThe entity? Omnichannel! And Shaft is the scapegoat.

spyder_leathershaft2_papers.en: This leaflet from the Shaft aims to gain the trust of the Fondent's people.

spyder_leathershaft2_dude.en: Shaft is is one of the largest mining companies in the region,\nespecially those that contribute to the communities.

spyder_leathershaft2_achievement.en: Shaft is proud to join the top businesses in this race toward a net-zero economy\nbecause we believe that climate change is not only one of the greatest risks facing Fondent,\nbut also one of the greatest opportunities for sustainable innovation.

spyder_leathershaft2_skeptic.en:
I don't trust Shaft. My geologist friend joined a team to explore the river basin
to determine the impact of deforestation and mining on the river and water quality.
This will mark the first ever evaluation of carbon and mercury production in mining ponds,
and their subsequent impact on water flowpaths, ever conducted in Fondent.

spyder_leather_maniac.en: How is your adventure so far? \n ... \n Wow, so talkative! You are really coming out of your shell.

spyder_leather_note1.en:
*rummages through the trash can, pulling out a banana peel with a few days' worth of mold on it* Ugh, wait, what's this? A leather notebook...
 Letter from Dr Henry, Former Nimrod Researcher
 I used to work for Nimrod, but I quit due to their priorities. They care more about profit and power than the well-being of tuxemon and their handlers.
 I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of Nimrod's tuxemon breeding programs.
 They're pushing these creatures to their limits, and it's only a matter of time before something goes terribly wrong.

spyder_leather_note2.en:
*digs deeper into the trash can, pushing aside banana peels and broken pens* Gross. Okay, what's this? Another notebook...
 Field Notes of Dr Sophia, Conservation Biologist
 My team and I have been monitoring tuxemon populations in the wild, and our data suggests that their numbers are declining at an alarming rate.
 This is likely due to habitat destruction and fragmentation, as well as the increasing demand for tuxemon for military and commercial purposes.
 We've observed that tuxemon are playing a crucial role in maintaining ecosystem balance in certain regions.
 Their loss could have far-reaching consequences for the environment and human societies that depend on these ecosystems.

spyder_leather_note3.en:
*pulls out a moldy pizza box and a stack of old newspapers* This trash can is a treasure trove of grossness. Oh, a journal...
 Journal of Dr John, Historian
 My research on the ancient empire's use of tuxemon has led me to question the official narrative.
 It appears that the empire's relationship with tuxemon was more complex and nuanced than previously thought...
 with evidence of both reverence and exploitation.
 I've discovered a series of ancient texts that suggest the empire's use of tuxemon was not solely for military purposes...
 but also for spiritual and ceremonial reasons.
 These texts, written in a long-forgotten language, offer a glimpse into a world where tuxemon were revered as sacred beings.
 As I delve deeper, I'm uncovering a rich tapestry of stories and legends... revealing the empire's profound connection to the tuxemon.
 Fascinating and unsettling, it raises more questions than answers about the empire's rulers.

spyder_leather_note4.en:
*reaches to the bottom of the trash can, pulling out a soggy notebook* Ugh, I hope this one isn't ruined. Ah, it's still legible...
 Notebook of Dr Maria, Tuxemon Biologist
 Observations of tuxemon behavior in the wild suggest that they are highly social creatures...
 with complex communication patterns and a strong sense of hierarchy.
 This challenges the common assumption that tuxemon are simply tools for human use.
 Preliminary data suggests that tuxemon are capable of experiencing stress and anxiety when subjected to intense training regimens.
 Further research is needed to understand the long-term effects of this stress on tuxemon well-being.

spyder_leather_sarah_greeting.en: Hey, what's up? I've been worried about my girlfriend lately. She's been acting really strange.\n Do you want to know what's been going on with her?

spyder_leather_sarah_yes.en: Okay, I'll tell you. I was there...

spyder_leather_sarah1.en: I don't know, Sarah. I'm feeling really conflicted about the mine right now. We've been getting some...\n unusual requests from our investors. Changes in our priorities.

spyder_leather_sarah2.en: What's going on? You've been distant lately. Is everything okay? What kind of requests?

spyder_leather_sarah3.en: I'm not supposed to say. But let's just say that our investors are very interested in the history of this place.\n I think they're looking for something specific. Something that could change everything.

spyder_leather_sarah4.en: But what about the mine? What about the people who work here? You didn't know what would happen. You didn't know about the eggs.

spyder_leather_sarah5.en: That's no excuse. I should have known better. I should have thought about the consequences.\n I'm one of the ones who proposed diverting the river and draining the lake. I'm one of the ones who made this happen.

spyder_leather_sarah6.en: You're doing the right thing now. You're trying to make it right. I'm here for you. We'll get through this together.

spyder_leather_sarah7.en: I hope so. I really do. But it's hard to shake off the feeling of guilt. It's hard to forget what we've done.

spyder_leather_sarah_after.en: I'm worried. What if we can't fix this? What if it's too late?

spyder_leather_sarah_no.en: No problem. I just thought you should know.

spyder_mansion_drinkingbuddya1.en: I wonder where our drinking buddy has gotten to?

spyder_mansion_drinkingbuddyb1.en: We started singing an old sea shanty, and by the time we'd done the Captain was missing!

spyder_mansion_drinkingbuddya2.en: There you are old friend! Let's get you back to river.

spyder_mansion_magician1.en: Welcome to the Bazaar Mansion.\n Please look past the mildew and creaky staircases; we've only just moved in.

spyder_mansion_painting.en: The eyes seem to follow you around the room.

spyder_mansion_picnicker.en: In Team Bazaar, we love to hang out in out-of-the-way places so Omnichannel can't spy on us.

spyder_mansion_barmaid.en: We're going to claim squatters' rights on this mansion.\n Just another thirteen and a half years to go!

spyder_mansion_magician2.en: Whoever owns this mansion seems to have forgotten about it.\n Can you imagine owning so many homes you forget about one?

spyder_output_nurse6.en: Feeling better already? I'm glad I could lend a hand.

spyder_mansion_captain1.en: Ahoy there! Thank you for finding me! \n I wandered off during last night's drinking session and fell down here. \n Hey, can you find the exit? Just shout out when you do.

spyder_basement_rogue.en: They really should patch up that hole in the floor.

spyder_basement_josephine1.en: Never mind my bellicose friend.\n Do you want to heal your Tuxemon?

spyder_top_magician1.en: Have you ever been to the Dojo in Flower City?\n No? A keen battler like you?

spyder_top_barmaid.en: The big corporations sell monsters\n that can only be morphed using their own proprietary technologies!

spyder_top_dancer.en: My parents think I'm paranoid, but I just don't trust Omnichannel.\n Or Scoop. Or Shaft. Or Greenwash. Or Nimrod, for that matter.

spyder_top_magician3.en: Head to the Dojo in Flower City and see how your battling skills stack up.

spyder_nimrod_dirk1.en: Are you here for the investor presentation? \n Nimrod shares are a great buy - armies always need weapons!

spyder_nimrod_guard1.en: Sorry bud, private meeting in progress. \n So buzz off!

spyder_nimrod_tru3.en: If those imbeciles in Shaft hadn't lost my dragon, beating you would have been a piece of cake.

spyder_xeon_creation_trigger_yes.en: I was exactly in that spot when I first presented Xeon to the world.

spyder_xeon_creation1.en: Dr. Elara: Ladies and gentlemen, I present to you: Xeon, a name that reflects the artificial yet distinct nature of this being.\n The term 'Xeon' is derived from the word 'xenos', meaning 'foreigner' or 'stranger'.\n This name acknowledges that Xeons are created by humans, yet they are a new and separate form of life, with their own unique skills and abilities.

spyder_xeon_creation2.en: Dr. Elara: As you can see, Xeon is a highly advanced artificial being, capable of complex thought and action.\n We've designed it to be a prototype for a new generation of intelligent machines.

spyder_xeon_creation3.en: Argon: This is incredible. How does it work?

spyder_xeon_creation4.en: Dr. Elara: Xeon's neural network is based on advanced algorithms and machine learning techniques.\n It's capable of learning and adapting at an exponential rate, making it potentially more intelligent than any human.

spyder_xeon_creation5.en: Zircon: That's both exciting and terrifying. What kind of implications does this have for humanity?

spyder_xeon_creation6.en: Dr. Elara: That's a good question. We're still exploring the possibilities and limitations of Xeon's capabilities.\n But we believe that it has the potential to revolutionize many industries and aspects of our lives.

spyder_xeon_creation7.en: Argon: But what about the risks? We've all heard warnings about the dangers of creating artificial intelligence that surpasses human capabilities.

spyder_xeon_creation8.en: Dr. Elara: We've taken every precaution to ensure that Xeon is safe and controllable.\n We've implemented strict safety protocols and guidelines for its use and development.

spyder_xeon_creation9.en: Zircon: I see. And what about the long-term implications? How do we ensure that Xeon doesn't become a threat to humanity in the future?

spyder_xeon_creation10.en: Dr. Elara: That's a question we'll continue to grapple with as we move forward with Xeon's development.\n But for now, we're focused on exploring its potential and ensuring that it's used responsibly.

spyder_xeon_creation11.en: Argon: I think we're just starting to scratch the surface of what Xeon can do.\n I'm excited to see where this technology takes us.

spyder_xeon_creation_trigger.en: I was just thinking about Xeon's creation. I have to admit, I'm still trying to process everything that's happened.\n I would have never imagined that the real reason behind Xeon's financial support was to use him for...\n other purposes. I'm deeply disappointed, to say the least. Would you like to hear the story of how Xeon was officially presented?

spyder_xeon_creation_trigger_after.en: I'm sorry you had to see that. It's hard for me to believe that my creation has been used for such... nefarious purposes.\n I can only hope that one day, Xeon will be able to fulfill his true potential, free from the influence of those who seek to exploit him.

spyder_xeon_creation_trigger_no.en: I understand. It's not an easy story to hear. I just wish things had turned out differently.

spyder_nimrod_pc_message1.en: E-mail from Bowie to Tru\n 'I need your help in locating the missing prototype. It was last seen in the testing room.'

spyder_nimrod_pc_message2.en: E-mail from Maverick to Tru\n 'Are you up for a guitar jam session tonight? I'll bring my axe and we can rock out.'

spyder_nimrod_note1.en: Note\n 'I've received an inquiry from the military about our hardware. Let's discuss how to proceed.'

spyder_nimrod_note2.en: Note\n 'We need to salvage what's left of the prototype and rebuild. Let's meet in the testing room to discuss.'

spyder_nimrod_zircon3.en: I see you've defeated Argon, I'm curious, how does it feel to win against an idealist?

spyder_nimrod_argon3.en: Zircon, I.. I didn't think you'd show up here. What do you want?

spyder_nimrod_zircon4.en: Oh, I just wanted to see how you're doing, Argon. And to remind you of our conversation a while back...

spyder_nimrod_zircon5.en: I see you're still as idealistic as ever, Argon. But I've come to realize that the only way to truly make a difference is through power.\n And I'm willing to do whatever it takes to achieve that.

spyder_nimrod_argon4.en: I'm sorry, Zircon. I think you've lost your way.

spyder_nimrod_zircon6.en: Enough talk. Let's quickly recharge and settle this once and for all.

spyder_nimrod_zircon_draw.en: It seems we're evenly matched, Argon. But this isn't the end.

spyder_nimrod_argon_draw.en: Indeed, Zircon. This is far from over.

spyder_nimrod_argon_won.en: Zircon, I'm sorry it had to end like this. You were once a friend and a colleague.

spyder_nimrod_zircon_lost.en: You'll never understand, Argon. You'll never see the truth.

spyder_nimrod_zircon_won.en: Ha! I've proven my superiority once again. You're no match for me, Argon.

spyder_nimrod_argon_lost.en: Zircon, you've changed. I don't know what's happened to you.

spyder_nimrod_berke1.en: Don't hurt me, I just write the contracts! I haven't done anything wrong! \n ... \n I mean, no one has done anything wrong. This is all legal and above board.

spyder_nimrod_pc_message3.en: E-mail from Argon to Lab\n 'I've made some breakthroughs in my research on tuxemon behavior. I'd love to share my findings with you all.'

spyder_nimrod_pc_message4.en: E-mail from Zircon to Lab\n 'I've published a new paper on advanced robotics. Check it out and let me know what you think.'

spyder_cottontown_enforcer.en: Butt out of it, kid, this is private property!

spyder_cottontown_enforcer2.en: It is I who must scram!

spyder_omnichannel_nurse.en: If that coward Beaverbrook thinks I'm going to risk my skin looking out for him,\n with mechanical dragons roaming the office,\n he's got another thing coming.

spyder_omnichannel1_spyderrookie.en: So, how do I apply for the witness protection program?\n Is there a form or something?

spyder_omnichannel2_pc.en: You have lowered the protective screens on all floors.

spyder_omnichannel3_spyderrookie.en: All my tuxemon passed out fighting the dragons. This is a bad time to forget to pack any potions!

spyder_omnichannel_note.en: Haha, suckers - you'll never find me. \n It's on the Omnichannel CEO's letterhead.

spyder_omnichannel_intro.en: The PC contains a file named 'Cut Intro'. Would you like to watch the cut scenes?

spyder_postintro00.en:
Well, that's a wrap. I hope that spot will bring in the sales we need.
 To be honest, I'm not entirely convinced that this 'deluxe Tuxemon' angle is going to fly.
 I mean, are people really going to pay a premium for a creature that can evolve instantly?
 And what's to stop them from just buying the tokens and evolving their own Tuxemon?

spyder_postintro01.en: And, the Tuxemon themselves are just a bunch of cute, marketable creatures designed to separate kids from their parents' money.\n I mean, we're creating a whole ecosystem around these things, and it's all just a big cash grab.\n We're exploiting people's desire for novelty and their willingness to spend money on anything that's trendy.

spyder_postintro02.en: But hey, it's a lucrative business, and we're just giving people what they want.

spyder_preintro00.en: Alright, let's get this over with. This is the tenth take. Can we please just nail this already?

spyder_preintro01.en: I swear, if I have to say 'deluxe Tuxemon' one more time, I'm going to lose it. Can't we come up with something more original?

spyder_preintro02.en: We're just going to end up with a bunch of cheesy, over-the-top marketing nonsense. Can't we aim higher than that?

spyder_preintro03.en: I'm starting to think that our marketing team has no idea what they're doing. 'Deluxe Tuxemon'? That's the best we can come up with?

spyder_preintro04.en: Okay, fine. Let's just get this done. But can we please, for the love of all things, try to sound at least somewhat sincere?

spyder_papertown_stopthere.en: Hey! What do you think you're doing?\n It's not safe to go into the wilds unless you have a tuxemon.\n Come buy one from our shop.

spyder_papertown_homemaker1.en: How are you, ${{name}}? \n Quiet and solemn as always, I see.
spyder_papertown_homemaker1.de: Wie geht es dir, ${{name}}?\nRuhig und feierlich wie immer, sehe ich.

spyder_papertown_myfirstmon.en: Hey, you came! That's great.\n When the fancy new tuxemon come through from the Cathedral, we just threw all our old ones in the bin!\n It seems like such a waste, especially when kids like you don't have any!

spyder_papertown_myfirstmon2.en: Here we go, looks like there's monsters in most of these bins. \n Sounds like my boss is calling. Good luck!

spyder_papertown_firstfight.en:
Hey, what are you doing rummaging in bins? That's gross - and it's against the rules! 
 ... 
 What, they were throwing out perfectly good tuxemon? 
 ... 
 Well, if they were perfectly good, they wouldn't throw them out, would they? 
 They must be inferior to the new models. Here, I'll show you!

spyder_papertown_firstfight_win.en: Huh, must be a fluke. There's no way the new model would be worse than the old!

spyder_papertown_firstfight_after.en: I'll heal you up this time, but I'm not a charity. Rest up at home next time your monsters get worn out.

spyder_papertown_firstfight_lose.en: As expected! Old models can't compare to new ones!

spyder_papertown_sunnyside.en: Sunnyside Manor: If we are not home leave a message with our housekeeper.

spyder_papertown_myfirstmon_notmet.en:
I recognize you, you're the kid who hasn't got a Gold Pass. 
 You know, I might be able to help you out. 
 When the fancy new tuxemon come through from the Cathedral, we just threw all our old ones in the bin!
 It seems like such a waste, especially when kids like you don't have any!

spyder_omnichannel_zoolander1.en: You really are a diamond in the rough, aren't you?

spyder_omnichannel_donald1.en: Back again? I should have fed you into the meat grinder back at Scoop HQ.

spyder_omnichannel_billie1.en:
Hey ${{name}}, hold up!
 I've been thinking a lot about what you did for my tuxemon, and I have to admit, it got me thinking about my own priorities.
 I realized I've been too focused on my own goals, and I haven't been doing enough to help others.
 That's why I'm coming with you to take down those tuxemon thieves.
 We owe it to ourselves, our tuxemon, and the entire community to put a stop to their nefarious plans.

spyder_omnichannel_dante1.en:
I've been watching you from the shop, and I have to say, I'm impressed.
 You've come a long way since you first got your tuxemon.
 I've been feeling a bit guilty, I'm the one who helped you get that tuxemon, and I feel like I've got a responsibility to help you see this through.
 Plus, I've got to admit, I'm a bit curious to see how this all plays out. So, I'm coming with you to take down those tuxemon thieves.
 Let's do this!

spyder_omnichannel_beaverbrook1.en:
Aha, it's too late for you! 
 Just out of the birthing pit ... the perfect monsters! 
 The genes of Drokoro incubated in dragon eggs dug up by Shaft 
 ... and fused with three killer robos designed by Nimrod. 
 The power of teamwork ... and it's in my hands.

spyder_omnichannel_dante2.en: That was a close one! I'm just glad we were able to take down those thieves.\n You've got a bright future ahead of you, ${{name}}. Don't forget about me when you're a famous tuxemon master, okay?

spyder_omnichannel_billie2.en: I'm proud of you, ${{name}}. You've come a long way since we first met.\n I think it's time for me to head back to Paper Town, but I'll never forget this adventure we shared.

spyder_omnichannel_beaverbrook2.en: No. It's not possible. \n Two upstarts, one with off-brand tuxemon, defeating my perfect creations. \n If I can just make it to my live radio interview, I'll command my enforcers to complete the takeover.

spyder_omnichannel_radioannounce.en:
This is FUD Radio, DJ Worm here and my co-host, "The Duke of Dead Air", broadcasting live from the Omnichannel Radio Studios. 
 We've got a full hour of lolly-pop, soft rock and accessible hip hop for you - but first, an interview with the head of Omnichannel! 
 Ah, it looks like Sir Beaverbrook couldn't make it, but in his place has sent a small child. Well, small child, what do you have to say? 
 ... 
 Speak up! You're on live radio! 
 ... 
 Huh, a conspiracy, you say? 
 ... 
 The Pillars were going to use Greenwash fusion technology, Nimrod killer robos and dragons dug up by Shaft ... 
 And they were going to use those fusions to take control of the entire region? 
 ... 
 And they deliberately spread the Virus to everyone's tuxemon using food from Scoop? 
 ... 
 And the Enforcers are in on it? 
 ... 
 And Omnichannel was behind the whole thing, using the media to keep people confused and distracted? 
 ... 
 You know we work for Omnichannel, right? Doc, please tell me you stopped broadcasting. Doc?! 
 ... 
 Ouch! Man I really wish Radio FUD didn't go out live. 
 I don't think people are going to be very happy with us.

spyder_route1_beachcomber.en: To run, just hold down the SHIFT key. \n Look! I'm free as an ELOFLY!

spyder_column1_sign.en: A rare ancient column. This was once part of a temple building.

spyder_column2_sign.en: A rare ancient column. Other ruins from the same culture can be found in Route 3.

spyder_route2_billie1.en: Hey cheapskate! Still got your stolen tuxemon?

spyder_route2_billie2.en: This was a fluke. My tuxemon were expensive, and that means that they're high quality.

spyder_route3_drag1.en:
AGENT: What happened to the excavation? 
 SHAFT BOSS ZOOLANDER: We got ... interrupted. By ... a kid. 
 AGENT: A kid?! 
 ZOOLANDER: But we did manage to recover one ... 
 AGENT: Hush! You know that's top secret. Alright, hand it over and scram! 
 ZOOLANDER: Okay, here ... uh!

spyder_route3_drag2.en: AGENT: What the?! Come with me, you can explain this to HQ!

spyder_route3_twig3.en: I will train more and become as strong as our Boss. \n She worked so hard to become the leader, I wanna be like her someday.

spyder_route3_surat3.en: Scram! You're getting in our way.

spyder_route3_roxby3.en: I hope Boss is not mad - she gets angry so fast, \n But she is a nice person and has a heart like a diamond.
spyder_route3_roxby3.de: Ich hoffe die Chefin ist nicht wütend - sie wird so schnell zornig,\nAber sie ist ein netter Mensch und hat ein Herz aus Gold.

spyder_route3_optional3.en: Enormous machines used for surface mining? Draglines!

spyder_route3_boulder.en: I need to find something in my bag that can help me push this boulder... Ah, if only I had the right item...

spyder_route4_billie1.en: I've got all the latest gear and the best tuxemon. What have you got?

spyder_route4_billie2.en: I guess money can't buy everything, after all.

spyder_route5_granny.en: This park is much more salubrious with the Nimrod construction keeping the Flower City riff-raff out.

spyder_output_nurse5.en: You're all patched up now, just take a load off and rest for a bit.

spyder_route6_billie1.en: Let's make it quick. I have a spa appointment in an hour.

spyder_route6_billie2.en: Huh. You're a better trainer than I thought.

spyder_routea_billie1.en: Hey cheapskate! We bought a little surprise for you from the store.

spyder_routea_billie2.en: It didn't work this time ... but at least we didn't fish it out of the trash!

spyder_routea_vince3.en: ... Gee, you really can't take a hint can you kid?

spyder_routea_vince4.en: Oh golly, my spine is broken! On my book, I mean.

spyder_routea_maniac.en: It's funny\n I come to the park to get away from people\n but I always end up running into someone I know!

spyder_routea_firefighter.en: It's so quiet here.\n It's a nice break from the noise of the city.

spyder_output_nurse4.en: All healed up! Now, let's get you back on your feet and get you moving again.

spyder_datacenter_sign.en: Welcome to the GoodChat data center. An Omnichannel subsidiary.

spyder_routeb_billie1.en: So you noticed the computer system is down too?\n Fancy a battle to pass the time? ...\n I guess there are more important things.

spyder_searoutec_nigel3.en: Sorry, I cannot permit entrance to the sacred cave while the Spyder Bite infection is still at loose.

spyder_searoutec_swimmer2.en: Keep it up! Not far to Paper Town now.

spyder_searoutec_swimmer1.en: I've heard strange cries and seen belching smoke from up ahead. I'm not swimming any further!

spyder_routee_calliope0.en: Stop right there! This place is off limits.

spyder_scoop_paine2.en: If those Enforcers hadn't come in and exposed their pet tuxemon to the disease, it would never have left the facility!

spyder_scoop_rubid2.en: Studies show that tuxemon find battling more stressful than living in these conditions.

spyder_scoop_berys2.en: Scoop did not release the disease! I promise you.

spyder_scoop_turner2.en: Remember, we had nothing to do with the disease getting out!

spyder_scoop_asta1.en:
Why yes, I am the inventor of the Extreme Restraints. 
 What are they, I hear you ask? 
 Only a set of manacles so powerful that even a dragon could not escape them. 
 They are being used in the containment unit to make sure none of the infected tuxemon escape.

spyder_scoop_asta2.en: Are you sure you want to leave Scoop HQ?

spyder_scoop_alyssa2.en: I'm telling you, we kept the disease under control!

spyder_scoop_taggart2.en: If you didn't steal the Extreme Restraints, who did?

spyder_scoop_donald2.en: You might just be strong enough to contain the escaped tuxemon. Please - do it for us.

spyder_scoop_cctv.en: The PC contains a file named 'CCTV'. Would you like to watch it?

spyder_scoop_arachne_flashback1.en: Nash: The Extreme Restraints are our most secure containment system yet.\n With these manacles, even the strongest tuxemon won't be able to break free from the containment unit.

spyder_scoop_arachne_flashback2.en: Reese: Good. We can't afford any more escapes, not with this disease outbreak spiraling out of control.\n These Restraints better be as effective as you claim.

spyder_scoop_arachne_flashback3.en: Nash: I guarantee it. The materials and design are impenetrable.\n As long as we keep the tuxemon locked up tight in these Restraints, the disease won't be going anywhere.

spyder_scoop_arachne_flashback4.en: Arachne: What do we have here? Looks like you've got quite the fancy set of restraints, don't you?

spyder_scoop_arachne_flashback5.en: Nash: Who are you? How did you get in here?

spyder_scoop_arachne_flashback6.en: Arachne: I'm here to relieve you of those lovely Extreme Restraints you've got. They'll make a fine addition to my collection.

spyder_scoop_arachne_flashback7.en: Reese: Stop right there! Those Restraints are crucial to containing the tuxemon outbreak.\n You have no idea what kind of damage you could cause if you take them.

spyder_scoop_arachne_flashback8.en: Arachne: Oh, I think I have a pretty good idea. And I don't really care about your little tuxemon problem. These Restraints are mine now.

spyder_scoop_arachne_flashback9.en: Nash: No, come back! We can't let those Restraints fall into the wrong hands!

spyder_scoop_arachne_flashback10.en: Reese: This is a disaster - without the Extreme Restraints, the containment unit is useless.\n The tuxemon could break free at any moment!

spyder_scoop_orba2.en: What am I doing here, for that matter?

spyder_scoop_haf1.en: I chased the people who stole the Restraints into this room. But then the sick tuxemon got in, and now we're all stuck!

spyder_scoop_arachne2.en: It's too late! I have the Extreme Restraints and there's nothing you can do about it.

spyder_scoop_landrace3.en: Thanks for getting rid of that brute that was blocking the way! \n Now we can escape with the Extreme Restraints!

spyder_scoop_arachne1.en: Oi! Can't you see we're in the middle of a villainous scheme?

spyder_scoop_weaver2.en: Yikes! It turns out crime doesn't pay!

spyder_timber_firefighter1.en: Hey, do you treat your tuxemon with proper respect?! \n Sorry, I can be very blunt. \n But you wouldn't believe the damage that tuxemon can do if they aren't taken proper care of.

spyder_timber_firefighter_nochillimp.en: Last week a Tikoal almost burnt down its owner's house!

spyder_timber_firefighter_willtrade.en: Hey, do you want a TIKOAL? I could really do with a CHILLIMP, if you've got one.

spyder_timber_dante2.en:
Hey buddy! 
 Are you planning to break into these HQ? Cool! 
 Make sure you're well prepared before you do, because it's difficult to get out once you're inside! 
 You'll need to call your mom to let her know you're safe. Use this app!

spyder_timber_dante1.en: Hey buddy! Cool to see you again.
spyder_timber_dante1.de: Hey Kumpel! Schön dich wieder zu sehen.

spyder_scoop_sign.en: Scoop HQ: Almost good enough to eat!

spyder_timber_mom1.en: Hey bojo, your BOARD doesn't work on water. Unless you've got power.

spyder_timber_mom2.en: What I mean to say is, here's a Surfboard! Ride it onto the river and see what happens!

spyder_outsidewalled_rogue1.en: Welcome to the Walled Garden. Gold Pass, please.

spyder_outsidewalled_rogue2.en: Oh, I see. \n This is an exclusive venue for elite battlers. No amateurs.

spyder_outsidewalled_rogue3.en: Please, come in. Let me take your coat.

spyder_outsidewalled_rogue4.en: Yeah, yeah, let a thousand cheap flowers bloom. In you go.

spyder_outsidewalled_midas1.en: Welcome one and all to the Public Garden. \n Lovers of tuxemon and the sport of tuxemon battling are our honored guests.

spyder_walled_billie1.en:
Well hello, ${{name}}.
 You scrub up alright.
 Don't worry, I'm not going to battle you.
 I don't want my win rate to get any worse.

spyder_output_nurse3.en: There we go! You're all fixed up. Don't worry about it, it's all part of the service.

spyder_wayfarer_shopkeeper.en: Sorry mate, no rooms available. \n The Enforcers say a rare disease has broken out among some guests' tuxemon, so we're under quarantine. \n I can heal your tuxemon for you, though?

spyder_wayfarer_nurse.en: There are sick tuxemon in this building. Best to leave it to the Enforcers to sort everything out. \n If you keep going, I can't make any promises about how they'll respond.

spyder_wayfarer1_maniac.en: Hey, buddy, do you want my Botbot?

spyder_wayfarer1_maniac1.en: I dunno how long I'm going to be stuck here, so it might as well get to explore with you.

spyder_enforcershq_trigger.en: A note from the Commander's office. Do you want to read it?

spyder_wayfarer_granny.en: I can't explain it ... one moment my Cairfrey was healthy, the next it was sick! \n At least the Enforcers arrived so soon.

spyder_wayfarer_maniac.en:
My tuxemon aren't sick! This is just an excuse to sell us medicine we don't need. 
 When I was your age, we didn't have medicine. We swam in mountain streams and if you got a sniffle, well, tough! 
 And anyway, I saw the Enforcers coming down Route 4 before anyone so much as sniffled, so how could 
 ... 
 ah ah achoo! 
 ... 
 That doesn't mean anything. I have an itchy nose.

spyder_wayfarerinn_tv1.en: The news is playing. \n The presenters are saying that there are unfounded rumors of an infection.

areyoureadytorumble.en: Are you ready to battle the Acolyte?

areyoureadytorumbleno.en: Very well, come back once you're prepared.

areyoureadytorumbleyes.en: Very well, before we fetch the Acolyte, we'll heal your Tuxemon.

areyoureadytorumbleyes2.en: There, now that you actually stand a chance, we will fetch the Acolyte.

challenger.en: Challenger!\nStep to the center and face me!

challenger2.en: You have done well to make it this far!

challenger4.en: Wait, this is your first battle?\nI was told I would be the third battle...

challenger6.en: This just means it will be easier to crush you!

challenger7.en: Ready yourself Challenger! It's time... TO FIGHT!

tabacongratsfirst2.en: I definitely wasn't expecting a performance like that. Kyle told us all that you would be an easy win.\nI guess he meant for you and not us!

tabacongratsfirst3.en: The other three acolytes are more powerful than me, so you may want to try and fight the wild Tuxemon in the passageways a bit.\nOther than that, Good Luck!\nIf you walk through the entrance behind me, you'll be teleported back to the main room.

acolyte1loss.en: Ha! Some Challenger you are. You'll have to do better than that to beat me!\nTry and level up your Tuxemon before facing me again!

acolyte1redo.en: So, you actually crawled back... Let's see how powerful you really are!

acolyte2challenger2.en: No, no, no. I'm down here... Or am I?\nMeet me in the center and we'll see... Or maybe we won't! Ha!

acolyte2challenger3.en:
Still wondering where I am? I thought you might!
I'm unlike any Acolyte you've faced before. I'm a shadow, unseen to anything and everyone.
Soon enough you will fear the true power of ME!
I am the second Acolyte! Garth!

acolyte2challenger4.en: Ahem. I SAID\nI am the second Acolyte! Garth!

acolyte2challenger6.en: Hi, sorry about that. I'm Garth.

acolyte2challenger7.en: NO CHRIS, IT'S TOO LATE! TURN THE LIGHTS BACK ON!!!

acolyte2challenger9.en:
Sorry again, some of these grunts are just completely incompetent.
I had this whole thing all planned out where I'd be the "unhinged" Acolyte and scare everyone.
Obviously that didn't happen, no thanks to Chris missing his mark.
As I was saying, my name is Garth and I'm the second Acolyte.
Presumably you're here to battle right? Well, let's get to it.
AND.... LET'S FIGHT!

acolyte2challengerwin.en: ... Well done. I put the blame of this loss entirely on Chris though.\nIf he hadn't missed his mark, I'm positive I could have won...\nIf you exit out the entrance behind me, you'll teleport back to the main room.

acolyte2challengerloss.en: Ha! You put up a good fight, but as always, no one can defeat the MIGHTY GARTH!\nFeel free to try again when you think you actually have a chance!

acolyte2challengerredo.en: Oh ho, back so quick? Well, let's get to it then!

acolyte3challenger3.en: I'm not ready yet. My Tuxemon aren't healed. This is bad.

acolyte3challenger5.en: Wait, yes, I can get one from the passageway. Yes, I think that would work. Yes... Yes indeed.

acolyte3challenger7.en: You just stay right here. I'll be back soon enough!

acolyte3challenger9.en: Catching tuxemon with your bare hands is always exhilarating, isn't it?\nThe fight, the struggle, there's nothing like it!

acolyte3challenger10.en: To feel them squirm and shake as you physically submit them to your will...\n...It's a glorious experience. Knowing that for once, you control the weapon, not the other way around.

acolyte3challenger11.en: In all my years of research, that feeling has always brought me the most satisfaction...

acolyte3challenger12.en: Well... up until last year when I learned the Truth. When I lost my job because THEY COULDN'T SEE!

acolyte3challenger14.en: Hmm, wait. Have you seen the Truth as well? Is there actually another like me?\nHmm... Yes! Well... Maybe. Wait, no. Wait. Wait wait wait...

acolyte3challenger15.en: Did you know that Tuxemon can become a part of you? An extension of your mind, specifically?

acolyte3challenger16.en: If you enforce your will on your Tuxemon enough, soon your psyches start to merge!

acolyte3challenger17.en: They called me crazy, they called me a fool. I was fired from the research division because they feared me. They feared what I could do!\nHumans and Tuxemon, merged together as one. So in sync that one can't be separated from the other... unless they burn out entirely.

acolyte3challenger18.en: Hee hee hee, but that will come back to bite them in the end, now won't it?\nFor only I know how to withstand a burnout!

acolyte3challenger19.en: Sure, it results in a little madness...

acolyte3challenger20.en: But that's the price anyone pays to see the Truth...

acolyte3challenger21.en: Hahahahaha, and after 30 merges and splits, I gladly pay it!

acolyte3challenger22.en: For to be enlightened like I have... No, to see the TRUTH like I have, there's nothing like it!

acolyte3challenger23.en:
Tuxemon aren't here to better our lives, no no no, they're here to DESTROY them. It's why we MUST end this all.
I'd do it myself if I could, but unfortunately, the only way to ensure the destruction of them is with their own kind.
Hence, Merging.
It's also rather intoxicating, knowing how much power you can wield...

acolyte3challenger24.en: Wait...\nWait wait wait wait wait... Why am I telling you this? You're not enlightened, you haven't seen the Truth.

acolyte3challenger25.en: YOU'RE JUST AN OMNICHANNEL PAWN! How DARE you come in here, interrogating me about the Truth, when you haven't even learned it.\nYou can't even BEGIN to understand, you filthy Omni scum.\nFor that, you and your Tuxemon must be... Annihilated...

acolyteiskayrazy2.en: Darnit Cam, we thought this would be a good way to bring you back into society.

acolyteiskayrazy3.en: SILENCE! You dare speak to me, you insignificant piece of-

acolytewasdefeated.en: Okay, Mack? Take him out of here.

thisisntthelastofme.en: Mark my words, this isn't the last you'll see of me!!

thisisntthelastofme2.en: Yeah, sure bud. Just start moving.

acolytewasdefeated2.en: Hey, sorry about that. I guess that Christie girl really did a number on him...

acolytewasdefeated3.en: He's been in therapy for the past year, ever since his Tuxemon experiments went haywire. We shut down everything after that.\nObviously he needs more time...

acolytewasdefeated4.en: Since there isn't a third acolyte anymore, you can just move on to the next one. I'll be sure to let everyone know.

acolytewasdefeated5.en: Good luck on the next one.

tabaacolyte4talk.en: Oh, hello there. I was beginning to think none of you would make it.\nCome on in, don't be shy.

tabaacolyte4talk2.en: That's better! As you might have guessed, I'm the fourth Acolyte.\nI'm the last one before you reach the Battle Area Master, and believe me, there's absolutely no way I'll let you past.\nFOR THE GLORY OF OMNICHANNEL... YOU SHALL NOT PASS!!

tabaacolyte4talk3.en: Heh. You've got spirit, I'll give you that.\nBut that's not even half of my power!\nFOR THE GLORY OF OMNICHANNEL... YOU SHALL NOT PASS!!

tabaacolyte4talk4.en: Hahaha! Is that really all you got?\nYou'll have no chance of beating the Battle Area Master if this is your limit. Let's test it more!\nFOR THE GLORY OF OMNICHANNEL... YOU SHALL NOT PASS!!

tabaacolyte4talkwon.en: Heh. Guess I was wrong. Looks like your limit is higher than mine...\nThe exit is behind me, it will take you back to the main room.\nGood luck against the Master.

mydadiscool.en: My dad works in the Battle Area! He's pretty cool right?\nI have to wait out here while he works though because Tuxemon are dangerous...

mydadiscool2.en: But... But that doesn't make him any less cool! He's brave and I'll be brave like him one day too!

itsforthefans.en: And a huge welcome to everyone watching from home! My name is Aeble and I am the CEO of Omnichannel.

itsforthefans2.en: You've all probably been on the edge of your seat waiting to see our first Trial contestants. Well, today you get to meet them!

itsforthefans3.en: From Flower City! The one who fought Tuxemon with his bare hands! Speck!

itsforthefans6.en: The recording has been stopped, sir.

itsforthefans9.en: Each of you should be stepping forward when your name is called. I won't have a bunch of insignificant kids destroying this for me.\nAlright?

itsforthefans10.en: START THE RECORDING! We'll pick it up at the introductions.

itsforthefans11.en: From Paper Town! The one and only Flower Demon, Christie!

itsforthefans12.en: And finally, the one you've all been hearing about. The one you've been talking about!\nFrom Taba Town! The Grunt subduer themselves!\n${{name}}!

abouttababa.en:
Now, you are probably all wondering what this Battle Area will entail. I know our Trial contestants definitely do!
The Taba Battle Area is the first of seven Battle Areas, culminating in the Championship battle in Cotton Town.
Each Battle Area will have a different requirement. Some will be mind challenges, others more physical.
This is all so that we can find the best of the best. The future of the Fondent Region and Omnichannel itself.

abouttababa5.en: The Requirement for the Taba Battle Area is...

abouttababa7.en:
Now, you will have to defeat all 4 Trial acolytes before being able to face the Battle Area Master.
Once you've defeated the Battle Area Master, you will receive your Trial medal for the Battle Area.
Good luck to all three of you, and remember...
WE ARE SAFETY, WE ARE ORDER, WE ARE OMNICHANNEL!

abouttababa8.en: Oh, and one more thing you three, no matter what you might think...\nWE are Fondent. Omnichannel is Fondent. Stay in line and don't muck anything up, otherwise there could be... issues

abouttababa9.en: Alright guys, CUT! That was great! I think we're good!

abouttababa10.en: Just cut out the last section and it will be perfect!

buh-bye.en: I'm heading out, but great work everyone! See you all later!

weneedhelp.en: Uhh... are we meant to just battle each other then?

weneedhelp2.en: I guess we'll just battle here?

weneedhelp3.en: I guess that works, this room doesn't seem like a battle room though.

weneedhelp4.en: No, you're right, but it's not like we were given any instructions...

explainthyselfchristie.en: By the way, why did Aeble call you the \"Flower Demon\"?\nHis nicknames for ${{name}} and I at least make sense

explainthyselfchristie2.en: Although yours, ${{name}}, sounds more interesting than mine.

explainthyselfchristie3.en: \"Flower Demon\" on the other hand sounds like more than a nickname.

explainthyselfchristie5.en: Come on, Christie. Give us something! We're all stuck here together anyways!

explainthyselfchristie6.en: ... Just like you... I have a past I'm running from...

maybeabattle2.en: Speck! I CHALLENGE YOU TO A BATTLE! PREPARE YOURSELF!

maybeabattle4.en: Oh, I see, you're just afraid to fight me huh? Maybe ${{name}} will have the guts, unlike you.

maybeabattle6.en: If it's a battle you want, THEN FINE!

haltyourbickering2.en: While I admire your enthusiasm, this isn't the place for battling each other.\nIt's also not the point of this Battle Area.

haltyourbickering3.en: Now, gather together again like the good children you are.

haltyourbickering4.en: If we're not supposed to fight each other, then who will we fight?

haltyourbickering5.en: Were you not listening? The acolytes of course. All 4 and then you can face the Battle Area Master.\nHonestly, I expected more from you two. I'm sure this is par for the course for the third wheel over there though.

dontbemean.en: Hey! Why are you so mean to ${{name}}? What did they do to you?

dontbemean2.en: I don't need a reason to do my job. But in this case...

seeyalater.en: Regardless, the 4 hallways lead to the 4 acolytes. Go and fight them or whatever.

seeyalater2.en: HEY! Aren't you going to give us that reason?

seeyalater4.en: I don't have to explain ANYTHING to you. That's what makes my job so GREAT!\nHopefully you lot don't die. It would be bad for ratings.

sorryabouthim.en: I'm sorry he's so mean to you ${{name}}

sorryabouthim2.en: Yeah! Just ignore him! After all, you have your girlfriends Misa and Allie watching from home! He probably has nobody!

sorryabouthim3.en: So? When you going to introduce us to 'em? We're practically family at this point!

sorryabouthim4.en: Christie, this is most definitely NOT the time.

doorchosen.en: But I guess we better focus on the Battle Area, since we're here and all.

doorchosen2.en: I'll start with door 3! Lucky number 3 after all!

doorchosen3.en: That girl will be the death of us.

doorchosen4.en: I'll start with door 2. Good Luck.

notyettababa.en: Only one person can challenge an Acolyte at a time. Please challenge another one.

notyettababafourth.en: This is the most powerful Acolyte before the Master, please finish challenging the others first.

itslocked.en: The doors are locked, maybe you should try defeating all 4 Acolytes first?

headupstairstababa.en: Huh. Well I definitely didn't expect you'd be the first to defeat all of them...

headupstairstababa2.en: Let me take one more look at your papers.

headupstairstababa4.en: This is all standard procedure, of course. We wouldn't want a cheater to make a mockery of the Trial after all.

headupstairstababa6.en: Received the papers back from Kyle

headupstairstababa7.en: The Battle Area Master is up those stairs on the far side.\nI'd wish you luck, but, y'know? I don't actually want you to win!

healspls2.en: So, you actually made it past the first Acolyte? Good Job.\nI'll take your Tuxemon real quick and heal them for you.

healsdone2.en: And... There you go. Good Luck with the next one.

healertabapassageway3.en: Y'know, that Christie girl is a real piece of work. She would not stop talking about how cute Lamberts are...\nOh, sorry. Give me your Tuxemon and I'll heal them.

healertabapassageway3-2.en: There! You should be all set now! Good luck on the next acolyte!

tabapassageway4heal.en: You've done well to make it this far, but he who lies ahead is more powerful than you expect.\nThere's no Tuxemon in this passageway, but that doesn't mean it's any easier than before...\nLet me heal your Tuxemon.

tabapassageway4heal2.en: Good luck on the path ahead...

finaltabahealer.en: You'll find the Battle Area Master upstairs. I'm actually excited for you!\nIt's a bit bittersweet though. This may be the final time I get to heal your Tuxemon...

finaltabahealer2.en: What? You thought Omnichannel would pay for more than a single grunt to heal Tuxemon?\nNope, it's been me the whole time!

taba_house1_calendar.en: It's a calendar with the 30 September and the 12 February circled in red.
taba_house1_calendar.de: Es ist ein Kalender und der 30. September und der 12. Februar sind rot eingekreist.

taba_house1_calendar_feb12.en: Today is ${{today}} — one of the circled dates. It must mean something to the people living here.

taba_house1_calendar_sep30.en: It's ${{today}}, one of the dates marked in red. Someone here clearly finds this day important.

taba_house1_husband1.en: Tuxemon! I was among the most skilled trainer!
taba_house1_husband1.de: Tuxemon! Ich gehörte zu den erfahrensten Trainern!

taba_house1_husband_extra.en: One day I'll prove I really was a top trainer. The world just wasn't ready for my talent.

taba_house1_husband_feb12.en: ${{today}}… the day I almost caught a mythical Tuxemon! My wife insists it was just a stray cat.

taba_house1_husband_sep30.en: ${{today}}… a legendary day in my career! Or it would've been, if anyone believed me.

taba_house1_wife_extra.en: Please don't encourage him. He'll start talking about imaginary battles again.

taba_house1_wife_feb12.en: Every year on ${{today}} he tells that same story. I've never seen a single piece of evidence.

taba_house1_wife_sep30.en: He insists ${{today}} is important. I think he just likes circling things on calendars.

taba_house1_reading.en: The book is Philosophy of Illusionary Studies by Jaiden Gemrevenza.
taba_house1_reading.de: Das Buch ist Philosophy of Illusionary Studies von Jaiden Gemrevenza.

taba_house1_watching.en: It's a documentary about the strangest and most wonderful Tuxemon in the region,\n as well as the strange behaviors they have adopted.
taba_house1_watching.de: Es ist ein Dokumentarfilm über die seltsamsten und wunderbarsten Tuxemon der Region,\n sowie die seltsamen Verhaltensweisen, die sie angenommen haben.

taba_house2_owner1.en: Welcome to the Legacy Library! Feel free to look around, but quiet please.
taba_house2_owner1.de: Willkommen in der Legacy-Bibliothek! Fühlen Sie sich frei, sich umzusehen, aber bitte ruhig.

taba_house2_reading1.en: The book is Visiting The King by Manolo Qai.
taba_house2_reading1.de: Das Buch ist Visiting The King von Manolo Qai.

taba_house2_reading2.en: The book is Raised By Dreams by Louis Etrergo.
taba_house2_reading2.de: Das Buch ist Raised By Dreams von Louis Etrergo.

taba_house2_reading3.en: The book is Children Without Honor by Leslie Greninza.
taba_house2_reading3.de: Das Buch ist Children Without Honor von Leslie Greninza.

taba_house2_reading4.en: The book is Sailing Into Eternitys by Laurine Doprachuld.
taba_house2_reading4.de: Das Buch ist Sailing Into Eternitys von Laurine Doprachuld.

taba_house2_reader1a.en: I feel better at the sight of a book or a bookstore.
taba_house2_reader1a.de: Ich fühle mich besser beim Anblick eines Buches oder einer Buchhandlung.

taba_house2_reader4a.en: Reading stimulates my mind in a way that TV and movies will never be able to do.
taba_house2_reader4a.de: Lesen stimuliert meinen Geist auf eine Weise, die Fernsehen und Filme niemals tun können.

taba_house2_reader3a.en: So I can live a thousand different lives.
taba_house2_reader3a.de: So kann ich tausend verschiedene Leben leben.

taba_house3_owner1.en: Welcome to The Thoughtful Leaf Inn!

taba_house3_client1a.en: I'm resting while my sister is probably reading some books.
taba_house3_client1a.de: Ich ruhe mich aus, während meine Schwester wahrscheinlich ein paar Bücher liest.

taba_house3_client2a.en: Thinking too much can harm us.
taba_house3_client2a.de: Zu viel Denken kann uns schaden.

taba_house3_client3a.en: It makes me think about my mom's house.
taba_house3_client3a.de: Es lässt mich an das Haus meiner Mutter denken.

taba_house3_client4a.en: I'm here with my sister, our uncle sent us both off to Taba to search for information.

taba_house3_client5a.en: Our uncles's TUMBLEBEE hives are dying out.

taba_house3_client5a_first.en: It could be! If we can all plant flowers, shrubs and trees, and stop mowing.

taba_house4_owner1.en: Welcome to The Honorable Seagulls Pub!

taba_house4_dish1.en: It's brown, dense, but it doesn't look like pudding...
taba_house4_dish1.de: Es ist braun, dicht, aber es sieht nicht aus wie Pudding...

taba_house4_waiter1.en: Many dishes dropped off the new menu!

taba_house4_client2a.en: Eh? Just filling up an empty stomach.
taba_house4_client2a.de: Gell? Einfach einen leeren Magen füllen.

taba_house4_client3a.en: Luckily I didn't pay for this. How can you pay for this?
taba_house4_client3a.de: Zum Glück habe ich nicht dafür bezahlt. Wie können Sie das bezahlen?

taba_house4_client1a.en: My grandma used to do a similar dish!
taba_house4_client1a.de: Meine Oma hat früher ein ähnliches Gericht zubereitet!

taba_town_sign_tuxemart.en: Tuxemart - A place to buy and sell items
taba_town_sign_tuxemart.de: Tuxemart - Ein Ort zum Kaufen und Verkaufen von Artikeln

taba_town_sign_tuxecenter.en: Tuxecenter - A place to heal your tuxemon
taba_town_sign_tuxecenter.de: Tuxecenter - Ein Ort, um Ihre tuxemon zu heilen

nopenotyet.en: Sorry, someone got injured on the route. It's closed right now.

darnitjohn2.en: DARN IT JOHN! Get out here!

uselessnes.en: You're absolutely useless John. I can't believe we were ever together.

cometomepls.en: NOW, EVERYONE, PLEASE COME TO THE CENTER OF TOWN. OMNICHANNEL WISHES TO ADDRESS YOU!

hellolovelypeople2.en: I know you're probably wondering why my Omni Knights and I are here.\nWait...

hellolovelypeople3.en: Are you really the only people in this town? There's no one here! This has GOT to be the smallest town in the Fondent Region.

hellolovelypeople4.en: I'm pretty sure there are houses in Cotton Town larger than this...

hellolovelypeople5.en: No... Wait... We are missing one person... \nThe lone Tuxemon breeder left in the Fondent region. The one that calls himself the Tuxemon Professor
hellolovelypeople5.de: Nein... Warte... Uns fehlt eine Person...\nDer einsame Tuxemon-Züchter verließ die Region Fondent. Derjenige, der sich Tuxemon Professor nennt

whereismyhairbrush.en: John, Grant, spread out. FIND HIM.

darnitjohn5.de: Warum bist du noch immer hier?

darnitjohn9.en: YOU IMBECILE!\nI will say this once and only once:\nGO. SEARCH. THE. HOUSES.

oopsie.en: Sorry you had to see that. He's just SOOOOOOO useless sometimes.

oopsie2.en: Why don't we wait for my knights to return. \nI hate to announce bad news alone.
oopsie2.de: Warum warten wir nicht auf die Rückkehr meiner Ritter?\nIch hasse es, nur schlechte Nachrichten zu verkünden.

maamiexist.en: Ma'am, He isn't in the house.

maamiexist3.en: There's a computer running Ubuntu.\nI was going to confiscate it, but I know Gnome isn't your style...

maamiexist4.en: Nah, leave it. These people obviously have terrible taste and despise usefulness and simplicity...\nCheck the lab now Grant. I'll wait for John.

itsmyaurababe2.en: Hmm, now that I actually look at you, you have a rather mysterious aura.\n...   ...   ...   ...\nWe should talk sometime. Maybe see me in Cotton Town?

maamnothing2.en: Darn it John! We were having a moment!\nWhat do you want?

maamnothing5.en: Ma'am, I haven't found him either.

maamnothing6.en: ... ... ... ...\n... Fine. We should probably head back to HQ and report.

seeme.en: Make sure you come see me...

solongjohn.en: John, you should stay here to keep the peace.\nI don't want you around anyways.

solongjohn2.en: Come on Grant, we have a schedule to keep.

knight4ispoor.en: She's really not a bad person.
knight4ispoor.de: Sie ist wirklich kein schlechter Mensch.

wherewasshe.en: She didn't tell us the bad news...

frowntime.en: I don't mind being here...\nIt's just lonely sometimes...

thetvbescreamin.en: Honey, wait. I turned on the TV and an Omnichannel press conference came on.\nWe should watch it.
thetvbescreamin.de: Schatz, warte. Ich schaltete den Fernseher ein und eine Omnichannel-Pressekonferenz ertönte.\nWir sollten es beobachten.

watchmewatchme.en:
What are you doing? Don't you know there's an early curfew?
... ... ... ...
... ... ... ...
You don't seem like a threat, so you can head on to town...
Just don't tell any of those Omnichannel thugs I let you past, M'kay?
watchmewatchme.de:
Warum gehst du in die Stadt, du weißt, dass es eine frühe Ausgangssperre gibt.
... ... ... ...
... ... ... ...
Du scheinst keine Bedrohung zu sein, also kannst du in die Stadt gehen...
Erzählen Sie einfach keinem dieser Omnichannel-Schläger, die ich Sie vorbeigelassen habe, okay?

grumble.en: Omnichannel are a bunch of thugs, but we don't have a choice...\nAs she always says, guess we have to work with them...
grumble.de: Omnichannel ist ein Haufen Schläger, aber wir haben keine Wahl...\nWie sie immer sagt, schätze, wir müssen mit ihnen arbeiten...

bobtalk.en: It would be nice if more people like you came around to say Hi...\nBy the way, Hello! Have a good day! Today or Tomorrow or any day will be great!
bobtalk.de: Es wäre schön, wenn mehr Leute wie Sie kommen würden, um Hallo zu sagen...\nÜbrigens, Hallo! Einen schönen Tag noch! Heute oder morgen oder jeder Tag wird großartig sein!

hmmm.en: I wonder what they're doing over there?

hmmm2.en: I heard they were making a new park. To \"Greenify the Area\"

hmmm3.en: What's the point? The Route is nearly all grass anyways.

hmmm4.en: Maybe they're making a water park!

hmmm5.en: Max, as much as you may want one, we've established this. They are not making, and will not make, a water park.

hmmm7.en: The Weather is nice though, isn't it?

timeforround2.en: ${{name}}! Finally! You're back! I was afraid you would miss the announcement!
timeforround2.de: ${{name}}! Endlich! Du bist zurück! Ich hatte Angst, dass Sie die Ankündigung verpassen würden!

timeforround22.en: Oh! You did get the potions! Good! Now we really need to get back.

moverocky.en: C'mon Rocky! You can move! I believe!

moverocky2.en: Well, you move when you're ready, I'll be here waiting.

taba_greeting1.en: Greeter Jaime: Hey there ${{name}}! Heard you got a Tuxemon, congrats! If you wanna grow your party, you'll need Tuxeballs.
taba_greeting1.de: Greeter Jaime: Hallo ${{name}}! Ich habe gehört, dass Sie ein Tuxemon haben, herzlichen Glückwunsch! Wenn Sie Ihre Gruppe vergrößern möchten, benötigen Sie Tuxeballs.

taba_greeting2a.en: The shop is doing a promo, here's some to get you started. You use them to capture Tuxemon. It's easier if they're weakend first though!

taba_greeting2b.en: Ah! I see you've already got some. You've got a good head on your shoulders ${{name}}, I'm sure you'll be a champ in no time.
taba_greeting2b.de: Ah! Ich sehe, Sie haben bereits welche. Du hast einen guten Kopf auf deinen Schultern ${{name}}, ich bin mir sicher, dass du in kürzester Zeit ein Champion sein wirst.

taba_greeting3.en: Good luck in your adventures ${{name}}, and remember to shop at Tuxemart for all your adventuring needs!\n...\nSorry about the sales pitch, it's my job.
taba_greeting3.de: Viel Glück bei Ihren Abenteuern ${{name}}, und denken Sie daran, bei Tuxemart für alle Ihre Abenteuerbedürfnisse einzukaufen!\n...\nSorry für das Verkaufsgespräch, es ist mein Job.

flower_city_description.en: Uniforms that guard you while you sleep!

potions_in_shop.en: The display case seems to have a lot of potions, must be pretty popular around here.

capture_devices_in_shop.en: Tuxeballs. How do they make these?

professorexists2.en:
You must be Callie's kid! I've heard so much about you from your mom.
What brings you in here for?
.... .... ....
Potions? Of course, you always need those!
Here, have a few on the house, courtesy of me.
professorexists2.de:
Du musst Callies Kind sein! Ich habe so viel über dich von deiner Mutter gehört.
Wofür kommen Sie hierher?
.... .... ....
Tränke? Die braucht man natürlich immer!
Hier, haben ein paar auf dem Haus, mit freundlicher Genehmigung von mir.

professorexists3.en: Oh! Excuse my manners, I can't believe I never introduced myself!\nMy name is Kay Wren, better known as the Tuxemon Professor.\nFor years now I've been the only person in the Fondent Region allowed to research Tuxemon.
professorexists3.de: Oh! Entschuldigen Sie meine Manieren, ich kann nicht glauben, dass ich mich nie vorgestellt habe!\nMein Name ist Kay Wren, besser bekannt als der Tuxemon Professor.\nSeit Jahren bin ich die einzige Person in der Fondent Region, die Tuxemon erforschen darf.

professorexists4.en:
Now, I know what you are thinking, why would they allow me?
Unfortunately for you, That secret is for me and me alone!
However, Omnichannel should be making a new announcement soon and I think you'll like it.
We'd better get you back home and watch the second announcement, Come on!
professorexists4.de:
Nun, ich weiß, was du denkst, warum sollten sie es mir erlauben?
Unglücklicherweise für dich, Dieses Geheimnis ist für mich und mich allein!
Omnichannel sollte jedoch bald eine neue Ankündigung machen und ich denke, Sie werden es mögen.
Wir bringen Sie besser nach Hause und schauen uns die zweite Ankündigung an: Komm schon!

theenergy.en: The energy of that man is boundless...
theenergy.de: Die Energie dieses Mannes ist grenzenlos...

water_traveller_1.en: Oh, are you a traveller? Welcome to our island.

water_traveller_2.en: Now might not be the best time to visit. Strange things are happening.

water_intro1.en: You have just crossed the desert and finally arrived in the Water Region.

water_intro2.en: A Legendary Tuxemon has been sighted near here, causing chaos across the island.

water_intro3.en: With your favourite Tuxemon, Agnite, you've come to help the people and solve their problems.

water_intro4.en: Go and face your biggest trial yet.

water_rude_dude1.en: RUDE DUDE: You're not a good Tuxemon trainer. Show me your strongest Tuxemon.\n I want to see what real power looks like, because I definitely don't have any of my own.

water_nice_mayor1.en: Hello and welcome to our village. We live in peace with our Tuxemon, floating gently on the ocean. Yes, the whole village floats.\n No, we don't know why.\n One day we woke up and everything was drifting. We decided to just go with it.

water_nice_mayor2.en: You need my permission before you can go any further on the island. Things have been getting unpredictable lately.\n Buildings wobble, the tides act strange, and sometimes the fish stare at us for too long. What brings you here?

water_nice_mayor3.en: Ah, you've heard of our problems. Strange things are happening in the North, and a mysterious Tuxemon has been sighted.\n People say it glides across the water without touching it, which is impressive and also a little rude.

water_nice_mayor4.en: You and your Tuxemon seem very strong. If you could help us find the strange Tuxemon and put an end to our troubles, we would be grateful.\n Our village doesn't have much, but we can offer moral support and a lot of floating.

water_rude_dude2.en: RUDE DUDE: Wow, this is a cool Tuxemon. You really don't deserve something this strong. Hope you don't mind if I take it.\n Actually, I hope you do mind. That makes it more fun.

water_rude_dude3.en: RUDE DUDE has stolen your Agnite. He sprints away like someone who has never considered consequences.

water_nice_mayor5.en: Nice Mayor: Oh my goodness. My son has stolen your Agnite. I am so sorry. He has a habit of making terrible decisions at high speed.\n I promise you, this is not normal behaviour. Well, not entirely normal.

water_nice_mayor6.en: Here, take two of my strongest Tuxemon. They have protected this village from storms, sea monsters, and once a very angry seagull.\n Please defeat my son and teach him a lesson before he steals something else.

water_nice_mayor7.en: You received Propellercat and Bugnin. They seem confused but willing.

water_nice_mayor8.en: I'm so sorry my son has stolen your Tuxemon. He thinks strength is something you grab and run away with.\n Please defeat him and help him understand that this is not how life works, even on a floating village.

water_niceguy1_2.en: You'll need permission from our mayor to go further on the island, due to how dangerous it's becoming.

water_niceguy2_1.en: Each village on our island has a special relationship with water.

water_niceguy2_2.en: For example, our village is right next to the ocean. Water is all around us.

water_oldman_1.en: This castle leads to a very dangerous part of the island.

water_oldman_2.en: Do not enter unless you know what you're doing.

water_goth1.en: What? A rude boy with a Tuxemon? Sorry, I haven't seen anyone come past me.

water_nurse1.en: Let me heal your Tuxemon for you.

water_nurse2.en: All healed. Take care out there.

water_helper1.en: I just saw a little boy run past me toward the outskirts of the village.

water_omniblock1.en: Omnichannel has restricted access to this section of the island for your safety.\n This area has been classified as a Tier 3 Hazard Zone under our Risk Mitigation Framework.\n Please do not panic. It is inefficient.

water_omniblock2.en: You must obtain the Mayor's authorization to proceed.\n This ensures alignment with our regional compliance protocols and prevents unexpected liability events.

water_rock1.en: Listen -> To -> This -> Guy -> He's -> Super -> Smart ->

water_outskirts_dude1.en: Oh no, you found me. I mean... haha. You walked right into my trap.\n I didn't actually set a trap, but pretending I did makes me feel smarter.

water_outskirts_dude2.en: Prepare to face the power of my... your Agnite.\n It likes me more than you. Probably. Maybe. I hope.

water_outskirts_dude3.en: What the... Agnite turned on me. Why would it do that.\n I fed it a snack. It was a rock, but still.

water_outskirts_dude4.en: You got Agnite back. It looks relieved, and also slightly embarrassed for you both.

water_outskirts_dude5.en: Grr... never mind. I have even stronger Tuxemon to defeat you with. Take this.\n I found them behind a tree. They might not even be mine.

water_outskirts_dude6.en: You have defeated the boy and recovered your Tuxemon.\n He looks frustrated, confused, and possibly hungry.

water_outskirts_dude7.en: You can now travel further on the island.\n The boy mutters something about revenge and snacks as he wanders off.

water_outskirts_niceguy1.en: It's so peaceful out here. But it would be nicer if it weren't for the Tuxemon hiding in the grass.

water_omni1.en: Omnichannel has designated this village as our regional operations hub.\n This strategic deployment enhances our ability to deliver value-driven security outcomes and also gives us a nice view.

water_omni2.en: Omnichannel will secure the Legendary Tuxemon and deliver optimized hero outcomes for this region.\n Our quarterly reports depend on it.

water_omni3.en: Omnichannel has identified that this village maintains a high-value relationship with water resources.\n Leveraging this asset is key to our long-term sustainability roadmap, or so the brochure says.

water_omni4.en: This village is positioned between two rivers, enabling streamlined waste-flow management.\n We simply place our materials in the river and let natural processes handle the rest.\n It's what we call eco-adjacent disposal.

water_omni5.en: Omnichannel advises against visiting the Snow or Volcano villages ahead.\n Those areas are currently undergoing stability recalibration. That means chaos.

water_omni6.en: Omnichannel will deploy certified field agents to stabilize those villages later.\n Please comply with all directives to ensure a seamless regional experience. Resistance creates paperwork.

water_nice_river1.en: This village used to be peaceful, until Omnichannel moved in.

water_cooldude1.en: I'm so cool. I must be the only person who's ever climbed this mountain alone.

water_cooldude2.en: Whoa. What are you doing here.

water_disciple1.en: You're almost halfway to the next village. Over this bridge is the halfway point where you can rest.

water_postboy.en: Umm... I think I'm lost. Am I anywhere near Taba Town.

water_guide1.en: To the North is an icy village being attacked by an angry Tuxemon.

water_guide2.en: To the East is a volcano village where the Legendary Tuxemon is causing chaos.

water_guide3.en: I'm too scared to go anywhere.

water_omniblock3.en: Omnichannel policy prohibits passage due to a high-risk Legendary Tuxemon ahead.\n Unauthorized entry may result in suboptimal customer experiences.

water_omniblock4.en: I work for Omnichannel now. Operational synergy, you know.\n We strive to deliver scalable safety solutions through proactive intervention and occasional shouting.

water_mayor1.en: A monster is attacking our village. Will you help us.\n The ice is cracking, the houses are shaking, and someone dropped their soup.\n It is chaos.

water_mayor2.en: Talk to me again when you're ready to fight it. The creature keeps circling the lake like it's judging us.\n I don't like being judged by something with claws.

water_mayor3.en: Here it is. The monster is attacking. Help. It is making loud noises and I am not emotionally prepared for this.

water_mayor4.en: By giddy, you've knocked that Tuxemon out to sea. That was impressive.\n The villagers can finally stop screaming. Mostly.

water_mayor5.en: I think you might be strong enough to stop the Legendary Tuxemon in the Volcano village.\n You should go there and help everyone. They are probably panicking too.

water_conifrost1.en: You feel a powerful presence behind you. The temperature drops just enough to make you question your life choices.

water_conifrost2.en: It's the Tuxemon you defeated when it attacked the village.\n It looks calmer now, like it has had a long think about its behaviour.

water_conifrost3.en: Conifrost was impressed by your strength and wants to help you stop the Legendary Tuxemon.\n It nods at you in a very serious, icy way.

water_conifrost4.en: Conifrost joined your team. It stands proudly, as if posing for a dramatic painting.

water_iceguy1_1.en: Our village has a special relationship with water. It's built on top of a frozen lake.

water_iceguy2_1.en: Help. Our village is being attacked by a dangerous Tuxemon.

water_iceguy2_2.en: Talk to our mayor if you want to help.

water_gemuar_before1.en: A frightening monster appears. You feel its power. It must be the Legendary Tuxemon causing all the problems here.\n Even the water seems nervous.

water_gemuar_before2.en: You sense that it wants to test your strength. It watches you like someone deciding whether you're impressive or disappointing.

water_gemuar_before3.en: LEGENDARY TUXEMON: Are you powerful enough to defeat me. Prepare yourself for a difficult battle, if you dare.\n I hope you stretched.

water_ending1.en: You have defeated the Legendary Tuxemon and restored peace to the region.\n The water settles, the wind calms, and someone in the distance sighs with relief.

water_ending2.en: Gemuar is impressed by your talent and has joined your team. It seems curious about what chaos you will stumble into next.

water_ending3.en: Your story in the Water Region has ended. You can keep playing if you want to, but this is the end of the game.\n The villagers will probably talk about you for years, even if they get some details wrong.

water_ending4.en: Well done and thank you for playing. See you in the next Tuxemon mod. Bring snacks next time.

water_hint1.en: This is the cave of the Legendary Tuxemon.

water_hint2.en: Somewhere in here, the Legendary Tuxemon is hiding. You must stop it and end its madness.

water_hint3.en: Walking inside water will heal your Tuxemon.

water_hint4.en: And don't worry about breathing underwater. A strange power allows you to breathe here.

water_hint5.en: And remember, walking in the water will heal all of your Tuxemon.

water_unusual1.en: Hello, strange person. I assume you've come to meet my friend. They call it the Legendary Tuxemon.\n I call it 'the one who keeps knocking things over'. Names are flexible.

water_unusual2.en: You think it's strange for someone to live underwater. Is it not stranger that you came all this way to meet me.\n People on the surface always rush. Down here, the water decides how fast you go. Usually slow.

water_unusual3.en: My friend is waiting for you to the North. They say they're very excited to meet you. They have been watching you through the currents.\n Not in a creepy way. Mostly.

water_volcano_oldman1.en: Are you ready to face the Legendary Tuxemon. Most people turn back at this point.\n Some pretend they forgot something at home. Others just faint.

water_volcano_oldman2.en: Walk into the water when you're prepared to face your hardest challenge yet. The entrance is down there.\n Yes, underwater. No, I don't know who designed it.

water_volcano_oldman3.en: That's right. Walk into the water. Don't worry about holding your breath. Something down there handles that for you.\n Probably magic. Or science. Or both.

water_volcano_guy1.en: Our village has a special relationship with water.

water_volcano_guy2.en: We live on a volcano where the heat boils water into steam, turning it into clouds.

water_volcano_guy3.en: I'm scared of the Legendary Tuxemon hiding in the nearby cave.

water_volcano_guy4.en: I need to run away to the Fondent region. I'm sure nothing dramatic is happening there.

water_volcano_guy5.en: It's hiding... the Legendary Tuxemon... in the lake North of here. I'm scared.
